translations.literal: Also selected and filled from northern Fierce Swift Staff Direct and from within the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies were also filled by selection from the northern Fierce Swift Staff Direct and from other armies.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，定州路都部署王超言；

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianping, Dingzhou Circuit supreme commander Wang Chao said;
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 5, Dingzhou route supreme commander Wang Chao said:

sentences.zh: 「緣邊有強梁輩常居四界，擾動邊境，請厚給金帛募充散員。」

translations.literal: 'Along the border there are powerful ruffians who constantly dwell in the four borderlands and disturb the frontier—we request generous payment in gold and silk to recruit them as Dispersed Attendants.'
translations.idiomatic: 'Powerful ruffians along the border constantly stir trouble in the frontier zones. I request generous payment in gold and silk to recruit them as Dispersed Attendants.'

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 散指揮左右班四。

translations.literal: Dispersed Commanders, left and right units, four.
translations.idiomatic: Dispersed Commanders, left and right units: four.

sentences.zh: 散都頭左右班二。

translations.literal: Dispersed Squad Chiefs, left and right units, two.
translations.idiomatic: Dispersed Squad Chiefs, left and right units: two.

sentences.zh: 金槍班左右班二，舊名內直。

translations.literal: Golden Spear Unit, left and right units, two—formerly called Inner Direct.
translations.idiomatic: Golden Spear Unit, left and right units: two—formerly called Inner Direct.

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，改選諸軍中善用槍槊者補之。

translations.literal: Early in Taiping Xingguo, changed to select from the various armies those skilled with spear and halberd to fill the posts.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Taiping Xingguo, the unit was refilled by selecting men skilled with spear and halberd from other armies.

sentences.zh: 東西班弩手、龍旗直、招箭班共十二，舊號東西班承旨。

translations.literal: East and West unit crossbowmen, Dragon Banner Direct, and Arrow Summoner Unit totaled twelve—formerly called East and West Imperial Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: East and West crossbowmen, Dragon Banner Direct, and Arrow Summoners totaled twelve units—formerly called East and West Imperial Attendants.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，改爲殿前侍，東西各第一第二弩手、龍旗直班六，並帶甲，選諸班及不帶甲班增補。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, changed to Palace Attendants; east and west each had First and Second Crossbowmen and Dragon Banner Direct units, six in all, all armored—selected from various Direct Units and unarmored units to fill vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 2, the unit was renamed Palace Attendants. East and West each had First and Second Crossbowmen and Dragon Banner Direct units—six armored units in all—filled by selection from other Direct Units and unarmored units.

sentences.zh: 其東第二茶酒及第三、西第四班不帶甲，並以諸軍員、使臣及沒王事者子弟爲之。

translations.literal: The East Second Tea and Wine and Third units, and West Fourth unit, were unarmored—all filled by surplus soldiers from various armies, court envoys, and sons of those who died in imperial service.
translations.idiomatic: The East Second Tea and Wine, East Third, and West Fourth units were unarmored, filled by surplus troops from other armies, court envoys, and sons of men who had died in imperial service.

sentences.zh: 又擇善弓箭者爲招箭班。

translations.literal: Also selected those skilled with bow and arrow to form the Arrow Summoner Unit.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled archers were also selected for the Arrow Summoner Unit.

sentences.zh: 散直左右班四。

translations.literal: Dispersed Direct, left and right units, four.
translations.idiomatic: Dispersed Direct, left and right units: four.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，以諸道募置藩鎮廳頭軍將及詣登聞院求試武藝者立。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, established from frontier-recruited frontier commission hall-head army commanders and those who came to the Petition Reception Court seeking trial of martial skill.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4, the unit was established from frontier-recruited hall-head army commanders and men who came to the Petition Reception Court to demonstrate martial skill.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，選諸節度使從人、騎御馬小底增補。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, selected military commissioners' attendants and Imperial Horse-Riding Lower Attendants to fill vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 1, vacancies were filled by selection from military commissioners' attendants and Imperial Horse-Riding Lower Attendants.

sentences.zh: 鈞容直班二。

translations.literal: Tuned Resonance Direct units, two.
translations.idiomatic: Tuned Resonance Direct: two units.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年，選諸軍諳曉音樂、騎御馬小底立。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo, selected from the various armies those versed in music and Imperial Horse-Riding Lower Attendants to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 3, it was established by selecting men versed in music from other armies and Imperial Horse-Riding Lower Attendants.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，改之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, renamed.
translations.idiomatic: Renamed in Chunhua 2.

sentences.zh: 外殿直班一。

translations.literal: Outer Palace Direct unit, one.
translations.idiomatic: Outer Palace Direct: one unit.

sentences.zh: 諸班衛士中年多者號看班外殿直，後削看班之號。

translations.literal: Among the various unit guards, those of advanced age were called Supervisory Outer Palace Direct; later the Supervisory designation was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Older guards among the units were called Supervisory Outer Palace Direct; later the Supervisory title was dropped.

sentences.zh: 或詣諸道攝軍校之職部分州兵，謂之權管。

translations.literal: Some went to various circuits to act in army officers' posts commanding part of prefectural troops—called Acting Command.
translations.idiomatic: Some were sent to circuits to act as army officers commanding prefectural troops—a role called Acting Command.

sentences.zh: 國初又有內員僚直，開寶中廢。

translations.literal: At the dynasty's founding there was also Inner Staff Direct; abolished in the Kaibao era.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding there was also an Inner Staff Direct unit, abolished in the Kaibao era.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，征太原，得上軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, campaigning against Taiyuan, obtained Upper Army troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, the Taiyuan campaign yielded Upper Army troops.

sentences.zh: 天禧四年，併入此班。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianxi, merged into this unit.
translations.idiomatic: Merged into this unit in Tianxi 4.

sentences.zh: 捧日並左射、钅屈直、弩手、左第五軍，總指揮三十五。

translations.literal: Sun-Holding together with Left Archer, Bent Spear Direct, crossbowmen, and Left Fifth Army—thirty-five commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Sun-Holding together with Left Archer, Bent Spear Direct, crossbowmen, and Left Fifth Army: thirty-five commands in all.

sentences.zh: 京師三十三，雍丘、鄭各一。

translations.literal: the capital thirty-three; Yongqiu and Zheng one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-three at the capital; one each at Yongqiu and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 舊號小底，周改爲鐵騎，太平興國二年改爲日騎，雍熙四年改今名。

translations.literal: Formerly called Lower Attendants; under Zhou changed to Iron Cavalry; in the second year of Taiping Xingguo changed to Sun Cavalry; in the fourth year of Yongxi changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Lower Attendants; under Zhou renamed Iron Cavalry; in Taiping Xingguo 2, Sun Cavalry; in Yongxi 4, the present name Sun-Holding.

sentences.zh: 分左、右廂，各四軍。

translations.literal: Divided into left and right wings, four armies each.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into left and right wings of four armies each.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，選善槍槊者充钅屈直。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, selected those skilled with spear and halberd to fill Bent Spear Direct.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 3, men skilled with spear and halberd were selected for Bent Spear Direct.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年，選善左射者爲左射。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunhua, selected those skilled in left-handed shooting for Left Archer.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 3, skilled left-handed archers were selected for Left Archer.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，選天武、拱聖、驍騎善弩射者爲弩手。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianping, selected from Heavenly Martial, Bowing to the Sage, and Fierce Cavalry those skilled in crossbow shooting for crossbowmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 5, skilled crossbowmen were selected from Heavenly Martial, Bowing to the Sage, and Fierce Cavalry for the crossbow unit.

sentences.zh: 契丹直三。

translations.literal: Khitan Direct, three.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan Direct: three.

sentences.zh: 咸平、許、壽各一。

translations.literal: Xianping, Xu, and Shou one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Xianping, Xu, and Shou.

sentences.zh: 後唐置，旋廢。

translations.literal: Established under Later Tang, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Established under Later Tang and soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 開寶三年，以遼人內附之衆復置。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaibao, re-established with Liao people who had submitted within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Re-established in Kaibao 3 with Liao subjects who had submitted.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，因事復置，旋廢。

translations.literal: In the Taiping Xingguo era, re-established on occasion, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Briefly re-established during Taiping Xingguo as circumstances required, then abolished again.

sentences.zh: 歸明渤海指揮二。

translations.literal: Returned-to-Civilization Bohai commands, two.
translations.idiomatic: Returned-to-Civilization Bohai: two commands.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，征幽州，以渤海降兵立。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, campaigning against Youzhou, established with surrendered Bohai troops.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Taiping Xingguo 4 with surrendered Bohai troops during the Youzhou campaign.

sentences.zh: 拱聖指揮二十一。

translations.literal: Bowing to the Sage commands, twenty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Bowing to the Sage: twenty-one commands.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 乾德中，選諸州騎兵送闕下，立爲驍雄，後改驍猛。

translations.literal: In the Qiande era, selected cavalry from various prefectures sent to court, established as Fierce Awesome—later changed to Fierce Fierce.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qiande era, prefectural cavalry sent to court became Fierce Awesome, later renamed Fierce Fierce.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，又改拱辰。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, again changed to Bowing to the Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Renamed Bowing to the Stars in Yongxi 4.

sentences.zh: 未幾改今名。

translations.literal: Before long changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, it received its present name, Bowing to the Sage.

sentences.zh: 吐渾小底舊指揮五，治平中並爲二。

translations.literal: Tuhun Lower Attendants, formerly five commands—in the Zhiping era merged into two.
translations.idiomatic: Tuhun Lower Attendants, formerly five commands, were merged into two in the Zhiping era.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，平太原，獲吐渾子弟，又選監牧諸軍中所有者充。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, pacifying Taiyuan, obtained Tuhun youths; also selected those found among the pasture-supervision armies to fill posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, pacification of Taiyuan yielded Tuhun youths; vacancies were also filled from pasture-supervision armies.

sentences.zh: 驍騎指揮二十三。

translations.literal: Fierce Cavalry commands, twenty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Cavalry: twenty-three commands.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年置，後又選掉搨索兵及左右教駿兵增置。

translations.literal: Established in the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo; later also selected Lasso troops and left and right Training Steeds troops to expand it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Taiping Xingguo 4; later expanded with Lasso troops and left and right Training Steeds.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，改殿前司步鬥弩手爲驍騎弩手。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, changed Palace Front Bureau Foot Combat crossbowmen to Fierce Cavalry crossbowmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4, Palace Front Bureau Foot Combat crossbowmen became Fierce Cavalry crossbowmen.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，選壯勇超絕者爲上驍騎，在本軍之上。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, selected those of outstanding strength and courage as Upper Fierce Cavalry, ranking above the main army.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, the strongest and bravest were selected as Upper Fierce Cavalry, ranking above the main force.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，分左、右廂。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianping, divided into left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: Divided into left and right wings in Xianping 5.

sentences.zh: 舊又有殿前小底。

translations.literal: Formerly there was also Palace Front Lower Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: There was formerly also a Palace Front Lower Attendants unit.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，選驍騎馬直及善射者充，後廢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao, selected Fierce Cavalry Horse Direct and skilled archers to fill it—later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 2, Fierce Cavalry Horse Direct and skilled archers filled the unit, which was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 驍勝左右指揮各五。

translations.literal: Fierce Victor left and right commands, five each.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Victor, left and right: five commands each.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年，選教駿、驍騎諸軍備征子弟材勇者立。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping, selected from Training Steeds and Fierce Cavalry various armies' campaign-ready sons of talent and courage to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Xianping 3 from campaign-ready sons of Training Steeds and Fierce Cavalry selected for talent and courage.

sentences.zh: 甯朔指揮十。

translations.literal: Secure Frontier commands, ten.
translations.idiomatic: Secure Frontier: ten commands.

sentences.zh: 京師、尉氏各三，雍丘、渭、河陽、河陰各一。

translations.literal: the capital and Weishi three each; Yongqiu, Wei, Heyang, and Heyin one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three each at the capital and Weishi; one each at Yongqiu, Wei, Heyang, and Heyin.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年，選教駿諸軍備征及外州兵立。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping, selected from Training Steeds various armies' campaign-ready troops and troops from outer prefectures to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Xianping 3 from campaign-ready Training Steeds and troops from outer prefectures.

sentences.zh: 龍猛指揮八。

translations.literal: Dragon Fierce commands, eight.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Fierce: eight commands.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，揀閱龍騎及諸州部送招獲群盜，取其材勇者立。

translations.literal: In the Taiping Xingguo era, inspected Dragon Cavalry and bandits captured and delivered from various prefectures, taking those of talent and courage to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established during Taiping Xingguo from Dragon Cavalry and captured bandits delivered from the prefectures, selected for talent and courage.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，又擇精悍者爲教閱龍猛以備禽盜，在本軍之上。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, again selected the elite and fierce as Drill Dragon Fierce to prepare for apprehending bandits, ranking above the main army.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, the most elite were selected as Drill Dragon Fierce to hunt bandits, ranking above the main force.

sentences.zh: 景德四年，又選龍騎、驍騎兵增之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde, again selected Dragon Cavalry and Fierce Cavalry troops to expand it.
translations.idiomatic: Expanded in Jingde 4 with troops from Dragon Cavalry and Fierce Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 飛猛指揮二。

translations.literal: Flying Fierce commands, two.
translations.idiomatic: Flying Fierce: two commands.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，選龍猛、驍騎兵子弟之材勇者立。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping, selected sons of Dragon Fierce and Fierce Cavalry troops of talent and courage to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Xianping 2 from talented, courageous sons of Dragon Fierce and Fierce Cavalry troops.

sentences.zh: 驍猛指揮四。

translations.literal: Fierce Fierce commands, four.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Fierce: four commands.

sentences.zh: 尉氏三、太康一。

translations.literal: Weishi three, Taikang one.
translations.idiomatic: Three at Weishi, one at Taikang.

sentences.zh: 舊號驍雄，太平興國中改。

translations.literal: Formerly called Fierce Awesome; changed in the Taiping Xingguo era.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Fierce Awesome; renamed during Taiping Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，以拱聖年多者爲拱辰軍，其次等者如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, those of advanced age in Bowing to the Sage became Bowing to the Stars Army; those of the next rank remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4, older Bowing to the Sage troops became Bowing to the Stars Army; those of the next rank stayed put.

sentences.zh: 景德四年，以拱聖年多者隸之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde, those of advanced age in Bowing to the Sage were attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 4, older Bowing to the Sage troops were transferred to it.

sentences.zh: 神騎指揮十八。

translations.literal: Divine Cavalry commands, eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Cavalry: eighteen commands.

sentences.zh: 雍丘十三，咸平五。

translations.literal: Yongqiu thirteen, Xianping five.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen at Yongqiu, five at Xianping.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，選驍雄新配人及教駿、借事等兵立。

translations.literal: In the second year of Duangong, selected newly assigned men from Fierce Awesome and Training Steeds, loaned-service, and other troops to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Duangong 2 from newly assigned Fierce Awesome troops and Training Steeds, loaned-service, and other units.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，廢掉搨索軍隸之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, abolished the Lasso Army and attached it thereto.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 2, the Lasso Army was abolished and absorbed into it.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，又擇教駿、備征及外州增之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping, again selected Training Steeds, campaign-ready, and outer prefecture troops to expand it.
translations.idiomatic: Expanded in Xianping 2 with Training Steeds, campaign-ready troops, and men from outer prefectures.

sentences.zh: 驍雄指揮四。

translations.literal: Fierce Awesome commands, four.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Awesome: four commands.

sentences.zh: 咸平、陳留各二。

translations.literal: Xianping and Chenliu two each.
translations.idiomatic: Two each at Xianping and Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 太平興國八年，遷驍猛中次等者立。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo, transferred those of the next rank in Fierce Fierce to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Taiping Xingguo 8 by transferring second-rank Fierce Fierce troops.

sentences.zh: 景德中，以驍騎、驍勝、寧朔軍年多者隸之。

translations.literal: In the Jingde era, those of advanced age in Fierce Cavalry, Fierce Victor, and Secure Frontier armies were attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingde, older troops from Fierce Cavalry, Fierce Victor, and Secure Frontier were transferred to it.

sentences.zh: 吐渾直指揮三。

translations.literal: Tuhun Direct commands, three.
translations.idiomatic: Tuhun Direct: three commands.

sentences.zh: 太原二，潞一。

translations.literal: Taiyuan two, Lu one.
translations.idiomatic: Two at Taiyuan, one at Lu.

sentences.zh: 太平興國八年，太原遷雲州及河界吐渾立，屯並、代州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo, established by relocating Tuhun from Yun Prefecture and the Yellow River frontier to Taiyuan—encamped at Bing and Dai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Taiping Xingguo 8 by relocating Tuhun from Yun Prefecture and the Yellow River frontier; garrisoned at Bing and Dai.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，又得雲、朔歸明吐渾增立，屯潞州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, again obtained returned-to-civilization Tuhun from Yun and Shuo to expand and establish it—encamped at Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Expanded in Yongxi 3 with returned Tuhun from Yun and Shuo; garrisoned at Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 安慶直四。

translations.literal: Anqing Direct, four.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing Direct: four.

sentences.zh: 太原一，潞三。

translations.literal: Taiyuan one, Lu three.
translations.idiomatic: One at Taiyuan, three at Lu.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，遷雲、朔及河東歸明安慶民分屯並、潞等州，給以土田。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, relocated returned-to-civilization Anqing people from Yun, Shuo, and Hedong to encamp separately at Bing, Lu, and other prefectures, granting them land.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, returned Anqing people from Yun, Shuo, and Hedong were resettled at Bing, Lu, and other prefectures and granted farmland.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年立。

translations.literal: Established in the fourth year of Yongxi.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Yongxi 4.

sentences.zh: 三部落指揮一。

translations.literal: Three Tribes command, one.
translations.idiomatic: Three Tribes: one command.

sentences.zh: 太原。

translations.literal: Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，親征幽州，遷雲、朔、應等州部落於并州，因立。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, personally campaigning against Youzhou, relocated tribes from Yun, Shuo, Ying, and other prefectures to Bing Prefecture—thereby established.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Taiping Xingguo 4 when tribes from Yun, Shuo, Ying, and other prefectures were relocated to Bing during the personal campaign against Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 清朔指揮四。

translations.literal: Clear Frontier commands, four.
translations.idiomatic: Clear Frontier: four commands.

sentences.zh: 西京二，許、汝各一。

translations.literal: Western Capital two; Xu and Ru one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two at the Western Capital; one each at Xu and Ru.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，遷雲、朔州民於內地，得自置馬以爲騎兵，謂之家戶馬。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, relocated people of Yun and Shuo prefectures to the interior—they could provide their own horses as cavalry, called Household Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, Yun and Shuo people resettled inland could provide their own horses as cavalry—called Household Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年立。

translations.literal: Established in the fourth year of Yongxi.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Yongxi 4.

sentences.zh: 擒戎指揮五。

translations.literal: Capture Barbarians commands, five.
translations.idiomatic: Capture Barbarians: five commands.

sentences.zh: 西京、許各二，汝一。

translations.literal: Western Capital and Xu two each; Ru one.
translations.idiomatic: Two each at the Western Capital and Xu; one at Ru.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，遷雲、朔州民於西京、許汝等州，給以土田，充家戶馬。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, relocated people of Yun and Shuo prefectures to Western Capital, Xu, Ru, and other prefectures, granting them land to serve as Household Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, Yun and Shuo people were resettled at the Western Capital, Xu, Ru, and elsewhere, granted farmland, and enrolled as Household Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年立。

translations.literal: Established in the second year of Duangong.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Duangong 2.

sentences.zh: 新安內員僚直五。

translations.literal: Xin'an Inner Staff Direct, five.
translations.idiomatic: Xin'an Inner Staff Direct: five.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，成德軍節度使田重進言；

translations.literal: In the second year of Duangong, Chengde Army military commissioner Tian Chongjin said;
translations.idiomatic: In Duangong 2, Chengde Army military commissioner Tian Chongjin said:

sentences.zh: 「易州靜砦兵先屯鎮州，賊陷勇陷穀，盡俘其家，請以其軍備宿衛。」

translations.literal: 'The Yizhou Quiet Fort troops had first been stationed at Zhen Prefecture. When bandits captured Yong Trap Valley, they took all their families prisoner. I request that this army be assigned to palace guard duty.'
translations.idiomatic: 'The Yizhou Quiet Fort garrison had first been posted at Zhen Prefecture. When bandits seized Yong Trap Valley, they captured every man's family. I ask that this unit be assigned to palace guard duty.'

sentences.zh: 因而立此直。

translations.literal: Thereupon this Direct unit was established.
translations.idiomatic: On this basis the Direct unit was established.

sentences.zh: 後廢，天聖後無。

translations.literal: Later abolished; none after Tiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Later abolished; none existed after Tiansheng.

sentences.zh: 散祗候左右班二。

translations.literal: Dispersed Palace Attendants, left and right units, two.
translations.idiomatic: Dispersed Palace Attendants, left and right units: two.

sentences.zh: 天聖前無。

translations.literal: None before Tiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: None existed before Tiansheng.

sentences.zh: 步鬥指揮六。

translations.literal: Foot Combat commands, six.
translations.idiomatic: Foot Combat: six commands.

sentences.zh: 尉氏、太康各一，蔡四。

translations.literal: Weishi and Taikang one each; Cai four.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Weishi and Taikang; four at Cai.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中增置，天聖前無。

translations.literal: Added in the Qingli era; none before Tiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Added during Qingli; none existed before Tiansheng.

sentences.zh: 御龍直左右二。

translations.literal: Imperial Dragon Direct, left and right, two.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dragon Direct, left and right units: two.

sentences.zh: 舊號簇御馬直，太平興國二年改爲簇御龍直，後改今名。

translations.literal: Formerly called Cluster Imperial Horse Direct; in the second year of Taiping Xingguo changed to Cluster Imperial Dragon Direct; later changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Cluster Imperial Horse Direct; renamed Cluster Imperial Dragon Direct in Taiping Xingguo 2, and later given its present name.

sentences.zh: 御龍骨朵子直左右二。

translations.literal: Imperial Dragon Bone Mace Direct, left and right, two.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dragon Bone Mace Direct, left and right units: two.

sentences.zh: 舊號骨䤪子直，太平興國二年改爲御龍散手直，後改今名。

translations.literal: Formerly called Bone Mace Direct; in the second year of Taiping Xingguo changed to Imperial Dragon Dispersed Hand Direct; later changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Bone Mace Direct; renamed Imperial Dragon Dispersed Hand Direct in Taiping Xingguo 2, and later given its present name.

sentences.zh: 御龍弓箭直五。

translations.literal: Imperial Dragon Bow and Arrow Direct, five.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dragon Bow and Arrow Direct: five.

sentences.zh: 選天武諸軍材貌魁傑者充。

translations.literal: Selected from Heavenly Martial's various armies those of outstanding physique and appearance to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: Filled by selection from Heavenly Martial troops of outstanding physique and appearance.

sentences.zh: 御龍弩直五。

translations.literal: Imperial Dragon Crossbow Direct, five.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dragon Crossbow Direct: five.

sentences.zh: 天武並寬衣、钅屈直、左射，總指揮三十四。

translations.literal: Heavenly Martial together with Loose-Robe, Bent Spear Direct, and Left Archer—thirty-four commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Martial together with Loose-Robe, Bent Spear Direct, and Left Archer: thirty-four commands in all.

sentences.zh: 京師三十三，咸平一。

translations.literal: the capital thirty-three; Xianping one.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-three at the capital; one at Xianping.

sentences.zh: 神勇上下共二十一指揮。

translations.literal: Divine Valor, upper and lower, twenty-one commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Valor, upper and lower wings: twenty-one commands in all.

sentences.zh: 乾德中，揀閱諸軍壯實而大體者立爲雄威。

translations.literal: In the Qiande era, inspected and selected from the various armies those strong, solid, and large in build to establish as Awesome Might.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qiande era, strong, solid, large-bodied troops were selected from other armies to establish Awesome Might.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，改爲雄勇。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, changed to Fierce Valor.
translations.idiomatic: Renamed Fierce Valor in Taiping Xingguo 2.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年改今名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Given its present name, Divine Valor, in Yongxi 4.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，選武藝超絕者立爲上神勇，以備擒盜。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, selected those of surpassing martial skill to establish as Upper Divine Valor, to prepare for capturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, troops of surpassing martial skill were selected as Upper Divine Valor to hunt bandits.

sentences.zh: 宣武上下共二十指揮。

translations.literal: Manifest Martial, upper and lower, twenty commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Manifest Martial, upper and lower wings: twenty commands in all.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，並效節、忠猛二軍立，又選諸軍及鄉兵增之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, established together with the Effect Integrity and Loyal Fierce armies; also selected from the various armies and militia to increase it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Taiping Xingguo 2 together with the Effect Integrity and Loyal Fierce armies, then augmented by selection from other armies and militia.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，又選軍頭司步直善用槍槊掉刀者立殿前步直，後廢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao, again selected from the Army Head Bureau Foot Direct those skilled with spear, halberd, and swinging blade to establish Palace Front Foot Direct; later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 2, skilled spear-, halberd-, and blade-fighting men were selected from the Army Head Bureau Foot Direct to establish Palace Front Foot Direct; the unit was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 虎翼太平興國中，揀雄武弩手立爲上鐵林，又于雄武、定遠、寧勝床子弩手、飛山雄武等軍選勁兵以增其數。

translations.literal: Tiger Wing—in the Taiping Xingguo era, selected Awesome Martial crossbowmen to establish as Upper Iron Forest; also from Awesome Martial, Secure Distance, Secure Victor Bed-Frame Crossbowmen, Flying Mountain Awesome Martial, and other armies selected strong troops to increase its numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiping Xingguo era, Awesome Martial crossbowmen were selected to form Upper Iron Forest under Tiger Wing; strong troops were also drawn from Awesome Martial, Secure Distance, Secure Victor Bed-Frame Crossbowmen, Flying Mountain Awesome Martial, and other regiments to increase its strength.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，改分左右四軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, reorganized into left and right, four armies.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4, it was divided into left and right wings of four armies each.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，選本軍精銳者爲上虎翼，以備禽盜。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, selected the elite of this army as Upper Tiger Wing, to prepare for capturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, this army's elite were selected as Upper Tiger Wing to hunt bandits.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，並廣勇軍隸之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping, Broad Valor army was also placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 2, the Broad Valor army was also placed under its command.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符六年，詔在京諸軍選江、淮士卒善水者習戰于金明池，立爲虎翼水軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, an edict ordered selection from the capital armies of Jiang and Huai troops skilled in water to drill in warfare at Jinming Pool, establishing them as Tiger Wing Navy.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 6, an edict ordered Jiang and Huai troops skilled in water warfare selected from the capital armies to drill at Jinming Pool and enrolled as Tiger Wing Navy.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮六十二，景德中增六。

translations.literal: Formerly sixty-two commands; in the Jingde era increased by six.
translations.idiomatic: It had formerly sixty-two commands; six were added in the Jingde era.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 雄勇舊號雄威，太平興國二年改今名。

translations.literal: Fierce Valor was formerly called Awesome Might; in the second year of Taiping Xingguo changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Valor was formerly Awesome Might; it received its present name in Taiping Xingguo 2.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，改神勇，復於本軍選退入次等者爲之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, changed to Divine Valor; again selected from this army those demoted to second rank to form Fierce Valor.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4 it was renamed Divine Valor; demoted second-rank men from that army were then selected to re-form Fierce Valor.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮五，至和五年增爲八。

translations.literal: Formerly five commands; in the fifth year of Zhihe increased to eight.
translations.idiomatic: It had formerly five commands; increased to eight in Zhihe 5.

sentences.zh: 咸平三，鄆二，許、鄭、滑各一。

translations.literal: Xianping three; Yan two; Xu, Zheng, and Hua one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three at Xianping; two at Yan; one each at Xu, Zheng, and Hua.

sentences.zh: 廣德開寶四年，平廣南，以其兵隸殿前司，次等隸八作司，闕則選廣南諸州兵補之。

translations.literal: Broad Virtue—in the fourth year of Kaibao, the south was pacified; its troops were placed under the Palace Front Bureau, second-rank under the Eight Works Bureau; vacancies were filled by selection from troops of the various prefectures of the south.
translations.idiomatic: Broad Virtue was established in Kaibao 4 when the south was pacified. Its troops entered the Palace Front Bureau, second-rank men the Eight Works Bureau; vacancies were filled from southern prefectural troops.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，選八作司之強壯者爲揀中。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, selected the strong from the Eight Works Bureau as Selected.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 3, strong men from the Eight Works Bureau were selected into the Selected unit.

sentences.zh: 總指揮十。

translations.literal: Ten commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Ten commands in all.

sentences.zh: 咸平、尉氏、陽武、河陽、滄、鞏、白波各一，西京三。

translations.literal: Xianping, Weishi, Yangwu, Heyang, Cang, Gong, and White Wave one each; Western Capital three.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Xianping, Weishi, Yangwu, Heyang, Cang, Gong, and White Wave; three at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 廣勇淳化二年，選神射、鞭箭、雄武、效忠等軍強壯善射者立爲廣武，大中祥符二年改今名。

translations.literal: Broad Valor—in the second year of Chunhua, selected from Divine Archer, Whip Arrow, Awesome Martial, Effect Loyalty, and other armies strong, skilled archers to establish as Broad Martial; in the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Broad Valor was established in Chunhua 2 from strong archers selected out of Divine Archer, Whip Arrow, Awesome Martial, Effect Loyalty, and other armies under the name Broad Martial; it received its present name in Dazhong Xiangfu 2.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮二十三，慶曆中增爲四十三，每指揮十爲一軍。

translations.literal: Formerly twenty-three commands; in the Qingli era increased to forty-three; every ten commands formed one army.
translations.idiomatic: It had formerly twenty-three commands, increased to forty-three during Qingli; every ten commands formed one army.

sentences.zh: 京師五，陳留二十二，咸平、東明、太原、胙城、南京各二，襄邑、陽武、鄆各一，滑三。

translations.literal: the capital five; Chenliu twenty-two; Xianping, Dongming, Taiyuan, Zuocheng, and Southern Capital two each; Xiangyi, Yangwu, and Yan one each; Hua three.
translations.idiomatic: Five at the capital; twenty-two at Chenliu; two each at Xianping, Dongming, Taiyuan, Zuocheng, and the Southern Capital; one each at Xiangyi, Yangwu, and Yan; three at Hua.

sentences.zh: 廣捷舊名左右平遠，建隆二年改。

translations.literal: Broad Swift was formerly called Left and Right Pacify Distance; changed in the second year of Jianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Broad Swift was formerly Left and Right Pacify Distance; renamed in Jianlong 2.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，又選廣德、神威等軍教以標槍旁牌補之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianping, again selected from Broad Virtue, Divine Awesome, and other armies, trained in standard spears and side shields, to fill vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 5, vacancies were filled by men from Broad Virtue, Divine Awesome, and other armies trained in standard spears and side shields.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮五，景祐中增五，明道中增十，慶曆增三十六，總五十六。

translations.literal: Formerly five commands; in the Jingyou era increased by five; in the Mingdao era increased by ten; in Qingli increased by thirty-six—fifty-six in all.
translations.idiomatic: It had formerly five commands, five added in Jingyou, ten in Mingdao, and thirty-six in Qingli—for fifty-six in all.

sentences.zh: 陳留八，咸平六，雍丘四，襄邑、尉氏、許各三，太康、扶溝、南京、亳、河陰、潁、寧陵各二，陳六，滑、曹、鄧、蔡、廣濟、穀熟、永城、襄城、葉各一。

translations.literal: Chenliu eight; Xianping six; Yongqiu four; Xiangyi, Weishi, and Xu three each; Taikang, Fugou, Southern Capital, Bo, Heyin, Ying, and Ningling two each; Chen six; Hua, Cao, Deng, Cai, Guangji, Gushu, Yongcheng, Xiangcheng, and Ye one each.
translations.idiomatic: Eight at Chenliu; six at Xianping; four at Yongqiu; three each at Xiangyi, Weishi, and Xu; two each at Taikang, Fugou, the Southern Capital, Bo, Heyin, Ying, and Ningling; six at Chen; one each at Hua, Cao, Deng, Cai, Guangji, Gushu, Yongcheng, Xiangcheng, and Ye.

sentences.zh: 雄威雍熙四年，選神勇兵退入第二等立爲神威，後改今名。

translations.literal: Awesome Might—in the fourth year of Yongxi, selected Divine Valor troops demoted to second rank to establish as Divine Awesome; later changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4, Divine Valor troops demoted to second rank were selected to form Divine Awesome, later renamed Awesome Might.

sentences.zh: 指揮十。

translations.literal: Ten commands.
translations.idiomatic: Ten commands.

sentences.zh: 考城、襄邑、陳留各一，南京四，陳二。

translations.literal: Kaocheng, Xiangyi, and Chenliu one each; Southern Capital four; Chen two.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Kaocheng, Xiangyi, and Chenliu; four at the Southern Capital; two at Chen.

sentences.zh: 宣威雍熙四年，選神勇、宣武兵退入次等者立。

translations.literal: Manifest Prestige—in the fourth year of Yongxi, selected Divine Valor and Manifest Martial troops demoted to lower rank to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Yongxi 4 from demoted Divine Valor and Manifest Martial troops under the name Manifest Prestige.

sentences.zh: 上下指揮二。

translations.literal: Upper and lower, two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and lower wings: two commands.

sentences.zh: 咸平、襄邑各一。

translations.literal: Xianping and Xiangyi one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Xianping and Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 龍騎建隆間以諸道招致及捕獲群寇立，號有馬步人，見陣即步鬥。

translations.literal: Dragon Cavalry—in the Jianlong era established by recruiting from the various circuits and capturing bandit gangs; called men-with-horse-who-fight-on-foot; upon sighting the enemy array they fought on foot.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Cavalry was established in the Jianlong era by recruiting across the circuits and capturing bandit bands. Its men were called horse-and-foot fighters: at the sight of the enemy line they dismounted to fight.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年，選本軍年多者爲帶甲剩員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunhua, selected those of advanced age in this army as Armored Surplus Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 3, older men in this army were selected as Armored Surplus Attendants.

sentences.zh: 咸平以後，又以本軍及龍猛退兵增之。

translations.literal: After Xianping, again increased from this army and demoted Dragon Fierce troops.
translations.idiomatic: After Xianping it was further augmented from this army and demoted Dragon Fierce troops.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮八，康定中，取配隸充軍者增置爲指揮二十，分三軍。

translations.literal: Formerly eight commands; in the Kangding era, taking those assigned to penal military service, increased and established to twenty commands, divided into three armies.
translations.idiomatic: It had formerly eight commands; in the Kangding era, men assigned to penal military service were enrolled to raise it to twenty commands in three armies.

sentences.zh: 京師四，尉氏、雍丘、咸平、鄭各二，南京、陳、蔡、河陽、潁、單、四波各一。

translations.literal: the capital four; Weishi, Yongqiu, Xianping, and Zheng two each; Southern Capital, Chen, Cai, Heyang, Ying, Shan, and White Wave one each.
translations.idiomatic: Four at the capital; two each at Weishi, Yongqiu, Xianping, and Zheng; one each at the Southern Capital, Chen, Cai, Heyang, Ying, Shan, and White Wave.

sentences.zh: 步鬥雍熙三年，選諸州廂軍之壯勇者立，後廢。

translations.literal: Foot Combat—in the third year of Yongxi, selected the strong and brave from the various prefectures' garrison armies to establish it; later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Foot Combat was established in Yongxi 3 from strong, brave garrison troops of the prefectures; it was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 此下二軍，天聖後無。

translations.literal: The two armies below—none after Tiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Neither of the two armies below existed after Tiansheng.

sentences.zh: 鞭箭雍熙三年，選兩浙兵爲鞭箭，次等者爲忠節鞭箭。

translations.literal: Whip Arrow—in the third year of Yongxi, selected Liang-Zhe troops as Whip Arrow; second-rank as Loyal Integrity Whip Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Whip Arrow was established in Yongxi 3 from Liang-Zhe troops; second-rank men formed Loyal Integrity Whip Arrow.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年並爲一。

translations.literal: In the second year of Duangong, merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: Merged into one unit in Duangong 2.

sentences.zh: 至道元年，發此兵援靈州芻粟，喪車重兵器於浦洛河，詔免死，後廢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao, this army was dispatched to carry forage to Ling Prefecture; chariots and heavy weapons were lost at the Pulu River; an edict spared them from death; later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 1, this unit was sent to convoy forage to Ling Prefecture and lost wagons and heavy weapons at the Pulu River. An edict spared them from execution; the unit was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 侍衛司侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、副都指揮使、都虞候各一人。

translations.literal: Imperial Guard Bureau: Imperial Guard Personal Guard cavalry and infantry commander-in-chief, deputy commander-in-chief, and chief adjutant, one each.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Guard Bureau had one commander-in-chief, one deputy commander-in-chief, and one chief adjutant for its Personal Guard cavalry and infantry.

sentences.zh: 馬軍都指揮使、副都指揮使、都虞候各一人，步軍亦如之。

translations.literal: Cavalry Bureau commander-in-chief, deputy commander-in-chief, and chief adjutant one each; infantry likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The Cavalry Bureau and Infantry Bureau each had one commander-in-chief, one deputy commander-in-chief, and one chief adjutant.

sentences.zh: 自馬步軍都虞候已上，其員全闕，即馬、步軍都指揮使等各領其務，與殿前號爲三司。

translations.literal: From chief adjutant of cavalry and infantry upward, when the posts were entirely vacant, the cavalry and infantry commanders-in-chief each took charge of their duties, and together with the Palace Front were called the Three Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: When the chief adjutant posts and above were unfilled, the cavalry and infantry commanders-in-chief each handled their own duties; together with the Palace Front Bureau they were called the Three Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 馬步軍有龍衛神衛左右四廂都指揮使、都虞候。

translations.literal: Cavalry and infantry had Dragon Guard and Divine Guard left and right four-wing commanders-in-chief and chief adjutants.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry and infantry had four-wing commanders-in-chief and chief adjutants for Dragon Guard and Divine Guard left and right.

sentences.zh: 每指揮有指揮使、副指揮使。

translations.literal: Each command had commander and deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Each command had a commander and deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 余如殿前司之制。

translations.literal: The remainder as under the Palace Front Bureau system.
translations.idiomatic: All other ranks followed the Palace Front Bureau system.

sentences.zh: 所領騎兵步兵之額敘列如左：

translations.literal: The roster of cavalry and infantry under its command is listed below:
translations.idiomatic: The cavalry and infantry under its command are listed below:

sentences.zh: 員僚直顯德中，周平三關，召募強人及選高陽關馳捷兵爲北面兩直。

translations.literal: Staff Direct—in the Xiangde era, Zhou pacified the Three Passes, recruited strong men and selected swift troops of Gaoyang Pass as the two northern Direct units.
translations.idiomatic: Staff Direct was established in the Xiangde era when Zhou pacified the Three Passes, recruiting strong men and selecting swift Gaoyang Pass troops as two northern Direct units.

sentences.zh: 建隆初，選諸州騎兵及蕃鎮廳頭召募人等爲左三直。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianlong, selected cavalry from the various prefectures and frontier commission hall-head recruits as the left three Direct units.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Jianlong, prefectural cavalry and frontier hall-head recruits were selected as the left three Direct units.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，平太原，選其騎兵爲右三直。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, Taiyuan was pacified; selected its cavalry as the right three Direct units.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, after Taiyuan was pacified, its cavalry were selected as the right three Direct units.

sentences.zh: 北面兩直，營貝、冀隸高陽關都部署。

translations.literal: The two northern Direct units encamped at Bei and Ji, subordinate to the Gaoyang Pass supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: The two northern Direct units were encamped at Bei and Ji under the Gaoyang Pass supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符中，改爲貝州左直、冀州右直，後改四直。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong Xiangfu era, changed to Bei Prefecture Left Direct and Ji Prefecture Right Direct; later changed to four Direct units.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong Xiangfu era they became Bei Prefecture Left Direct and Ji Prefecture Right Direct; later reorganized as four Direct units.

sentences.zh: 京師二，恩、冀各一。

translations.literal: the capital two; En and Ji one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two at the capital; one each at En and Ji.

sentences.zh: 龍衛舊號護聖。

translations.literal: Dragon Guard was formerly called Protect Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Guard was formerly Protect Sage.

sentences.zh: 周廣順中，改龍捷。

translations.literal: In the Zhou Guangshun era, changed to Dragon Swift.
translations.idiomatic: Renamed Dragon Swift under Zhou in the Guangshun era.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，揀去衰老，以諸州所募精勁者補之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, selected out the aged; filled with the elite recruits of the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianlong 2, the aged were weeded out and replaced with elite prefectural recruits.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，改分左、右廂。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, reorganized into left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: Divided into left and right wings in Taiping Xingguo 2.

sentences.zh: 四年，平太原，選其降兵爲揀中龍衛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Taiyuan was pacified; selected its surrendered troops as Selected Dragon Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, after Taiyuan was pacified, surrendered troops were selected into Selected Dragon Guard.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，又揀善槍槊者爲钅屈直。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi, again selected those skilled with spear and halberd for Bent Spear Direct.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 2, men skilled with spear and halberd were selected for Bent Spear Direct.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年，選剩員堪披甲者爲帶甲剩員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunhua, selected surplus attendants fit to wear armor as Armored Surplus Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 3, surplus attendants fit for armor were selected as Armored Surplus Attendants.

sentences.zh: 五年，又揀善左射者爲左射。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, again selected those skilled in left-handed shooting for Left Archer.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, skilled left-handed archers were selected for Left Archer.

sentences.zh: 指揮四十四。

translations.literal: Forty-four commands.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-four commands.

sentences.zh: 京師三十八，雍丘、尉氏、河陽各一，澶三。

translations.literal: the capital thirty-eight; Yongqiu, Weishi, and Heyang one each; Chan three.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-eight at the capital; one each at Yongqiu, Weishi, and Heyang; three at Chan.

sentences.zh: 忠猛咸平一年置。

translations.literal: Loyal Fierce—established in the first year of Xianping.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Fierce was established in Xianping 1.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 定州。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At Ding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 散員咸平五年置。

translations.literal: Dispersed Attendants—established in the fifth year of Xianping.
translations.idiomatic: Dispersed Attendants was established in Xianping 5.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 定州。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At Ding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 驍捷周顯德中，平三關，揀諸州士卒壯勇者爲河北驍捷。

translations.literal: Fierce Swift—in the Zhou Xiangde era, the Three Passes were pacified; selected strong, brave troops from the various prefectures as Hebei Fierce Swift.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Swift was established in the Zhou Xiangde era when the Three Passes were pacified, selecting strong, brave prefectural troops as Hebei Fierce Swift.

sentences.zh: 宋初，隸高陽關都部署。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, subordinate to the Gaoyang Pass supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Song it was under the Gaoyang Pass supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，廢左右驍武，以其兵來隸。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, abolished Left and Right Fierce Martial; its troops came to be subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianlong 2, Left and Right Fierce Martial were abolished and their troops were absorbed into it.

sentences.zh: 乾德中，又選備征及嵐州歸附之兵爲河南驍捷，其後止以驍捷爲名。

translations.literal: In the Qiande era, again selected Prepared Campaign and Lan Prefecture surrendered troops as Henan Fierce Swift; afterward only Fierce Swift was used as the name.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qiande era, Prepared Campaign and Lan Prefecture surrendered troops were selected as Henan Fierce Swift; later only the name Fierce Swift was kept.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，平太原，揀閱降兵爲揀中驍捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, Taiyuan was pacified; inspected and selected surrendered troops as Selected Fierce Swift.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4, after Taiyuan was pacified, surrendered troops were inspected and selected into Selected Fierce Swift.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，又置新立驍捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, again established Newly Established Fierce Swift.
translations.idiomatic: Newly Established Fierce Swift was added in Chunhua 4.

sentences.zh: 至道三年，分驍捷爲左、右廂。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhidao, divided Fierce Swift into left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Swift was divided into left and right wings in Zhidao 3.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，以其年多者爲帶甲剩員。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianping, those of advanced age were made Armored Surplus Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 5, its older men were made Armored Surplus Attendants.

sentences.zh: 指揮二十六。

translations.literal: Twenty-six commands.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six commands.

sentences.zh: 尉氏新立、陳揀中各一，恩十四，冀十。

translations.literal: Weishi Newly Established and Chen Selected one each; En fourteen; Ji ten.
translations.idiomatic: One each for Weishi Newly Established and Chen Selected; fourteen at En; ten at Ji.

sentences.zh: 雲騎舊號左右備征，建隆二年改。

translations.literal: Cloud Cavalry was formerly called Left and Right Prepared Campaign; changed in the second year of Jianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud Cavalry was formerly Left and Right Prepared Campaign; renamed in Jianlong 2.

sentences.zh: 開寶以後，募子弟爲雲騎，以其次爲武騎，又選騎兵之次等爲武騎，又選本軍年多者爲帶甲剩員。

translations.literal: After Kaibao, recruited sons and younger brothers as Cloud Cavalry; second-rank as Martial Cavalry; also selected second-rank cavalry as Martial Cavalry; also selected those of advanced age in this army as Armored Surplus Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: After Kaibao, younger kinsmen were recruited as Cloud Cavalry and second-rank men as Martial Cavalry; second-rank cavalry were also enrolled as Martial Cavalry, and older men in the unit as Armored Surplus Attendants.

sentences.zh: 指揮十五。

translations.literal: Fifteen commands.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen commands.

sentences.zh: 京師十一，陳留、西京各一，鞏二。

translations.literal: the capital eleven; Chenliu and Western Capital one each; Gong two.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven at the capital; one each at Chenliu and the Western Capital; two at Gong.

sentences.zh: 歸明神武太平興國四年，親征幽州，以其降兵立此軍。

translations.literal: Returned-to-Civilization Divine Martial—in the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, personally campaigning against Youzhou, established this army with its surrendered troops.
translations.idiomatic: Returned-to-Civilization Divine Martial was established in Taiping Xingguo 4 with surrendered troops during the personal campaign against Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 初指揮一，後增爲四。

translations.literal: At first one command; later increased to four.
translations.idiomatic: It began with one command and later grew to four.

sentences.zh: 雍丘。

translations.literal: Yongqiu.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongqiu.

sentences.zh: 克勝本潞州騎兵，端拱初升。

translations.literal: Overcome Victor was originally Luzhou cavalry; promoted at the start of Duangong.
translations.idiomatic: Overcome Victor began as Luzhou cavalry and was promoted at the start of Duangong.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 潞。
