translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 3, Loyal Submission troops were selected to fill its gaps.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，擇本軍善水戰者爲上虎翼，六，年又選江、淮習水卒于金明池按試戰棹，立爲虎翼軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, those of this army skilled in naval warfare were chosen as Upper Tiger Wing, six; the next year soldiers versed in water from Jiang and Huai were selected and tested on war boats at Jinming Pool, and Tiger Wing Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 5, six men of this army skilled in naval combat were chosen as Upper Tiger Wing; the next year, water-trained soldiers from the Jiang and Huai regions were examined on war boats at Jinming Pool and enrolled as Tiger Wing Army.

sentences.zh: 江、浙、淮南諸州，亦准此選置。

translations.literal: The various prefectures of Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan likewise followed this standard in selection and establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures of Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan were likewise organized by the same selection.

sentences.zh: 七年，改爲虎翼水軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, changed to Tiger Wing Naval Force.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, it was renamed Tiger Wing Naval Force.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮七十五，慶曆中，增置二十一，總九十六。

translations.literal: Formerly seventy-five commands; during Qingli, twenty-one were added, totaling ninety-six.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered seventy-five commands; twenty-one were added during Qingli, for ninety-six in all.

sentences.zh: 京師九十並水軍一，襄邑、東明、單各一，長葛一。

translations.literal: the capital ninety plus one naval; Xiangyi, Dongming, and Shan one each; Changge one.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety at the capital plus one naval unit; one each at Xiangyi, Dongming, and Shan; one at Changge.

sentences.zh: 奉節乾德三年平蜀，得其兵立爲奉議，後改今名。

translations.literal: Reverent Obedience—in the third year of Qiande Shu was pacified; their troops were obtained and established as Reverent Counsel, later changed to the present name.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent Obedience was established in Qiande 3 with troops taken when Shu was pacified, first as Reverent Counsel and later renamed.

sentences.zh: 景德三年，又選立上奉節。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde, Upper Reverent Obedience was again selected and established.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 3, Upper Reverent Obedience was again selected and established.

sentences.zh: 指揮五，京師。

translations.literal: Five commands, the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Five commands at the capital.

sentences.zh: 武衛太平興國中，募河北諸州兵立。

translations.literal: Martial Guard—during Taiping Xingguo, troops from various Hebei prefectures were recruited to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Guard was established during Taiping Xingguo by recruiting troops from Hebei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮十六，慶曆中，河北增置爲指揮六十七。

translations.literal: Formerly sixteen commands; during Qingli, Hebei additions brought it to sixty-seven commands.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered sixteen commands; during Qingli, Hebei additions raised it to sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 南京、真定、淄各四，北京、澶、相、邢、懷、趙、棣、洺、德、祁、通利、乾寧、廣濟各一，青五，鄆、徐、兗、曹、濮、沂、濟、單、萊、濰、登、淮陽、瀛、博各二，齊、密、滄各三。

translations.literal: Southern Capital, Zhending, and Zi four each; Northern Capital, Chan, Xiang, Xing, Huai, Zhao, Di, Ming, De, Qi, Tongli, Qianning, and Guangji one each; Qing five; Yun, Xu, Yan, Cao, Pu, Yi, Ji, Shan, Lai, Wei, Deng, Huaiyang, Ying, and Bo two each; Qi, Mi, and Cang three each.
translations.idiomatic: Four each at the Southern Capital, Zhending, and Zi; one each at the Northern Capital, Chan, Xiang, Xing, Huai, Zhao, Di, Ming, De, Qi, Tongli, Qianning, and Guangji; five at Qing; two each at Yun, Xu, Yan, Cao, Pu, Yi, Ji, Shan, Lai, Wei, Deng, Huaiyang, Ying, and Bo; three each at Qi, Mi, and Cang.

sentences.zh: 雄武並雄武弩手、床子弩雄武、揀中雄武、飛山雄武、揀中歸明雄武，總指揮三十四。

translations.literal: Awesome Martial together with Awesome Martial crossbowmen, bed-frame crossbow Awesome Martial, Selected Awesome Martial, Flying Mountain Awesome Martial, and Selected Returned-to-Light Awesome Martial—thirty-four commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Awesome Martial, together with Awesome Martial crossbowmen, bed-frame crossbow Awesome Martial, Selected Awesome Martial, Flying Mountain Awesome Martial, and Selected Returned-to-Light Awesome Martial, totaled thirty-four commands.

sentences.zh: 京師十三，太原、尉氏、南京、鄭、汝、寧陵各二，咸平、東明、雍丘、襄邑、許、曹、廣濟、穀熟、長葛各一。

translations.literal: the capital thirteen; Taiyuan, Weishi, Southern Capital, Zheng, Ru, and Ningling two each; Xianping, Dongming, Yongqiu, Xiangyi, Xu, Cao, Guangji, Gushu, and Changge one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen at the capital; two each at Taiyuan, Weishi, the Southern Capital, Zheng, Ru, and Ningling; one each at Xianping, Dongming, Yongqiu, Xiangyi, Xu, Cao, Guangji, Gushu, and Changge.

sentences.zh: 川效忠太平興四三年，選諸州廂兵歸京師者立。

translations.literal: Sichuan Effect Loyalty—in the third year of Taiping Xingguo, garrison troops from various prefectures who had returned to the capital were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Effect Loyalty was established in Taiping Xingguo 3 by selecting garrison troops from various prefectures who had been sent back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧兵部送京師者產爲川效忠。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, Weizhao and Kening troops from the Sichuan gorges who had been escorted to the capital were again selected and established as Sichuan Effect Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, Weizhao and Kening troops from the Sichuan gorges who had been escorted to the capital were again enrolled as Sichuan Effect Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 景德元年，以德清廂軍及威遠兵增之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingde, Deqing garrison troops and Weiyuan troops were added to supplement it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 1, it was supplemented with Deqing garrison troops and Weiyuan troops.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮二十八，後減爲七。

translations.literal: Formerly twenty-eight commands; later reduced to seven.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered twenty-eight commands and was later reduced to seven.

sentences.zh: 南京六，寧陵一。

translations.literal: Southern Capital six, Ningling one.
translations.idiomatic: Six at the Southern Capital; one at Ningling.

sentences.zh: 效順宋初，征潞州，以降卒立。

translations.literal: Loyal Submission—in the early Song, campaigning against Luzhou, established with surrendered troops.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Submission was established in the early Song with surrendered troops from the Luzhou campaign.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 襄邑。

translations.literal: Xiangyi.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 雄勝開寶中，以剩員立。

translations.literal: Fierce Victor—during Kaibao, established from surplus personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Victor was established during Kaibao from surplus personnel.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，選入上鐵林，餘如故。

translations.literal: During Taiping Xingguo, selected men entered Upper Iron Forest; the remainder stayed as before.
translations.idiomatic: During Taiping Xingguo, selected men were transferred to Upper Iron Forest while the rest remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 又有雄勝剩員。

translations.literal: There were also Fierce Victor surplus personnel.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a Fierce Victor surplus contingent.

sentences.zh: 指揮三。

translations.literal: Three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Three commands.

sentences.zh: 峽、冀、濟各一。

translations.literal: Xia, Ji, and Jizhou one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Xia, Ji, and Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 揀中雄勇開寶中立，以常寧雄勇、效順等軍剩員中選其強者立爲揀中。

translations.literal: Selected Fierce Valor established during Kaibao; from surplus personnel of Changning Fierce Valor, Loyal Submission, and other armies, the strongest were selected and established as Selected.
translations.idiomatic: Selected Fierce Valor was established in Kaibao by choosing the strongest surplus men from Changning Fierce Valor, Loyal Submission, and other units.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，又選歸遠軍爲新立。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Return Distance troops were again selected for new establishment.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 2, Return Distance troops were again selected for a new unit.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮四，後損爲一。

translations.literal: Formerly four commands; later reduced to one.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered four commands and was later reduced to one.

sentences.zh: 襄邑。

translations.literal: Xiangyi.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 懷勇開寶四年，揀蜀兵之在京師者立，指揮三。

translations.literal: Cherish Valor—in the fourth year of Kaibao, Sichuan troops at the capital were selected to establish it; three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Cherish Valor was established in Kaibao 4 by selecting Sichuan troops then at the capital; three commands.

sentences.zh: 雍丘二，陳一。

translations.literal: Yongqiu two, Chen one.
translations.idiomatic: Two at Yongqiu; one at Chen.

sentences.zh: 威寧淳化中，部送西川賊帥五小波脅從之兵歸京師立。

translations.literal: Awesome Tranquility—during Chunhua, troops coerced into following the bandit leader Wu Xiaobo in western Sichuan were escorted back to the capital and established.
translations.idiomatic: Awesome Tranquility was established during Chunhua with troops coerced into following the western Sichuan bandit Wu Xiaobo, who were escorted back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，又以散員直增補。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, it was further supplemented with loose-attendant direct troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 1, it was further filled out with Loose Attendant Direct troops.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 許。

translations.literal: Xu.
translations.idiomatic: At Xu.

sentences.zh: 飛虎本虎翼、廣武兵屯西川無家屬者，太平興國中，歸京師。

translations.literal: Flying Tiger—originally Tiger Wing and Broad Martial troops garrisoned in western Sichuan without families; during Taiping Xingguo, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Flying Tiger comprised Tiger Wing and Broad Martial troops garrisoned in western Sichuan without families; during Taiping Xingguo they returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 指揮三。

translations.literal: Three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Three commands.

sentences.zh: 陳留二，咸平一。

translations.literal: Chenliu two, Xianping one.
translations.idiomatic: Two at Chenliu; one at Xianping.

sentences.zh: 懷順本淮南兵，舊號懷德。

translations.literal: Cherish Submission—originally Huainan troops; formerly called Cherish Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Cherish Submission was originally Huainan troops formerly known as Cherish Virtue.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年改。

translations.literal: Changed in the second year of Jianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Renamed in Jianlong 2.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 霸。

translations.literal: Ba.
translations.idiomatic: At Ba.

sentences.zh: 歸聖開寶七年，以李從善所領兵及水軍立。

translations.literal: Returned to Sagacity—in the seventh year of Kaibao, established with troops led by Li Congshan and naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: Returned to Sagacity was established in Kaibao 7 with troops under Li Congshan and naval forces.

sentences.zh: 八年，平江南，又以其降兵增補，指揮一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Jiangnan was pacified; surrendered troops further supplemented it—one command.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after Jiangnan was pacified, surrendered troops further supplemented it; one command.

sentences.zh: 雍丘。

translations.literal: Yongqiu.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongqiu.

sentences.zh: 順聖太平興國中，部送兩浙兵歸京師立。

translations.literal: Compliant Sagacity—during Taiping Xingguo, Liang-Zhe troops were escorted back to the capital and established.
translations.idiomatic: Compliant Sagacity was established during Taiping Xingguo with Liang-Zhe troops escorted back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 鞏。

translations.literal: Gong.
translations.idiomatic: At Gong.

sentences.zh: 懷恩乾德三年，平蜀，得其軍立。

translations.literal: Cherish Grace—in the third year of Qiande, Shu was pacified; their army was obtained and established.
translations.idiomatic: Cherish Grace was established in Qiande 3 with the army taken when Shu was pacified.

sentences.zh: 指揮三。

translations.literal: Three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Three commands.

sentences.zh: 荊南二，鄂一。

translations.literal: Jingnan two, E one.
translations.idiomatic: Two at Jingnan; one at E.

sentences.zh: 揀中懷愛本蜀兵，與懷恩同立，又拔精銳者爲揀中。

translations.literal: Selected Cherish Affection—originally Sichuan troops; established together with Cherish Grace; the finest were then culled as Selected.
translations.idiomatic: Selected Cherish Affection was originally Sichuan troops established with Cherish Grace; the finest were then split off as the Selected unit.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧兵次等者立爲牽船，以給河漕之役。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, second-rank Weizhao and Kening troops from the Sichuan gorges were again selected and established as Boat-Towing to supply river transport corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, second-rank Weizhao and Kening troops from the Sichuan gorges were enrolled as Boat-Towing to serve river transport duty.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮三，後損爲一。

translations.literal: Formerly three commands; later reduced to one.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered three commands and was later reduced to one.

sentences.zh: 寧陵。

translations.literal: Ningling.
translations.idiomatic: At Ningling.

sentences.zh: 勇捷太平興國四年，征太原立，分左、右廂，以諸州庫兵補左廂，廣濟、開山兵補右廂。

translations.literal: Brave Swift—in the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, established campaigning against Taiyuan; divided into left and right wings; state-store troops from various prefectures filled the left wing, Guangji and Kaishan troops the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: Brave Swift was established in Taiping Xingguo 4 during the Taiyuan campaign, divided into left and right wings; state-store troops from various prefectures filled the left wing and Guangji and Kaishan troops the right.

sentences.zh: 指揮二十六。

translations.literal: Twenty-six commands.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six commands.

sentences.zh: 襄邑、北京、澶、陳、壽、汝、曹、宿各二，咸平、西京、南京、亳、甯、洪、河陰、鞏、長葛、韋城各一。

translations.literal: Xiangyi, Northern Capital, Chan, Chen, Shou, Ru, Cao, and Su two each; Xianping, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Bo, Ning, Hong, Heyin, Gong, Changge, and Weicheng one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two each at Xiangyi, the Northern Capital, Chan, Chen, Shou, Ru, Cao, and Su; one each at Xianping, the Western Capital, the Southern Capital, Bo, Ning, Hong, Heyin, Gong, Changge, and Weicheng.

sentences.zh: 威武太平興國四年，征太原立，分左、右廂，以江南歸化兵補左廂，兩浙順化兵補右廂。

translations.literal: Martial Awesome—in the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, established campaigning against Taiyuan; divided into left and right wings; Jiangnan Returned-to-Civilization troops filled the left wing, Liang-Zhe Submissive Civilization troops the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Awesome was established in Taiping Xingguo 4 during the Taiyuan campaign, divided into left and right wings; Jiangnan Returned-to-Civilization troops filled the left wing and Liang-Zhe Submissive Civilization troops the right.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，又立下威武。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Lower Martial Awesome was again established.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 5, Lower Martial Awesome was again established.

sentences.zh: 共指揮十三。

translations.literal: Thirteen commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen commands in all.

sentences.zh: 西京、河陽、鄭、鄆、澶、滑、濮、通利、鞏、河陰、永城各一，曹二。

translations.literal: Western Capital, Heyang, Zheng, Yun, Chan, Hua, Pu, Tongli, Gong, Heyin, and Yongcheng one each; Cao two.
translations.idiomatic: One each at the Western Capital, Heyang, Zheng, Yun, Chan, Hua, Pu, Tongli, Gong, Heyin, and Yongcheng; two at Cao.

sentences.zh: 靜戎弩手選江南歸化兵及諸州廂兵壯實者立。

translations.literal: Pacifying Frontier crossbowmen—selected from Jiangnan Returned-to-Civilization troops and sturdy garrison troops from various prefectures to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying Frontier crossbowmen were established by selecting Jiangnan Returned-to-Civilization troops and sturdy garrison troops from various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 指揮四。

translations.literal: Four commands.
translations.idiomatic: Four commands.

sentences.zh: 河陽、澶、衛、通利各一。

translations.literal: Heyang, Chan, Wei, and Tongli one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Heyang, Chan, Wei, and Tongli.

sentences.zh: 平塞弩手本兩浙順化軍，揀其強壯立爲弩手，又以江、浙逋負官物隸窯務徒役者爲揀中平塞。

translations.literal: Pacifying Barrier crossbowmen—originally Liang-Zhe Submissive Civilization Army; the strong were selected as crossbowmen; those from Jiang and Zhe who owed government goods and were assigned to kiln works labor were made Selected Pacifying Barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying Barrier crossbowmen were drawn from the Liang-Zhe Submissive Civilization Army, with the strongest selected as crossbowmen; men from Jiang and Zhe who owed government goods and were assigned to kiln labor became Selected Pacifying Barrier.

sentences.zh: 指揮四。

translations.literal: Four commands.
translations.idiomatic: Four commands.

sentences.zh: 咸平、亳、河陽、白波各一。

translations.literal: Xianping, Bo, Heyang, and White Wave one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Xianping, Bo, Heyang, and White Wave.

sentences.zh: 新立弩手本勁勇兵，太平興國中，選其善弩者立。

translations.literal: Newly Established crossbowmen—originally Vigorous Valor troops; during Taiping Xingguo, those skilled with crossbows were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Newly Established crossbowmen were drawn from Vigorous Valor troops; during Taiping Xingguo, skilled crossbowmen were selected to form the unit.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 廣濟。

translations.literal: Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangji.

sentences.zh: 忠勇咸平五年，以易州兵能禽賊者立。

translations.literal: Loyal Valor—in the fifth year of Xianping, established with Yizhou troops who could capture bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Valor was established in Xianping 5 with Yizhou troops who had proved able to capture bandits.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 成都。

translations.literal: Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: At Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 甯遠大中祥符六年，選西川克寧、威棹兵立。

translations.literal: Secure Distance—in the sixth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Kening and Weizhao troops from western Sichuan were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Secure Distance was established in Dazhong Xiangfu 6 by selecting Kening and Weizhao troops from western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮五，皇祐及至和中，增置爲八。

translations.literal: Formerly five commands; during Huangyou through Zhihe, increased to eight.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered five commands; during Huangyou through Zhihe, it was increased to eight.

sentences.zh: 戎三，遂、梓、嘉、雅、江安各一。

translations.literal: Rong three; Suí, Zi, Jia, Ya, and Jiang'an one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three at Rong; one each at Suí, Zi, Jia, Ya, and Jiang'an.

sentences.zh: 忠節太平興國三年，選諸州廂軍之強壯者立。

translations.literal: Loyal Integrity—in the third year of Taiping Xingguo, strong garrison troops from various prefectures were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Integrity was established in Taiping Xingguo 3 by selecting strong garrison troops from various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧兵立爲川忠節。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, Weizhao and Kening troops from the Sichuan gorges were again selected and established as Sichuan Loyal Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, Weizhao and Kening troops from the Sichuan gorges were again enrolled as Sichuan Loyal Integrity.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮二十四，後增教閱忠節總爲六十。

translations.literal: Formerly twenty-four commands; later Drill-Inspected Loyal Integrity was added for sixty in all.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered twenty-four commands; after Drill-Inspected Loyal Integrity was added, the total reached sixty.

sentences.zh: 雍丘、襄邑、寧陵各三，陳留、咸平、東明、亳、河陰、永城各二，南京五，太康、陽武、許、江寧、揚、廬、宿、壽、楚、真、泗、泰、滁、岳、澧、池、歙、信、太平、饒、宣、洪、虔、吉、臨江、興國、廣濟、南康、廣德、長葛各一，合流四。

translations.literal: Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Ningling three each; Chenliu, Xianping, Dongming, Bo, Heyin, and Yongcheng two each; Southern Capital five; Taikang, Yangwu, Xu, Jiangning, Yang, Lu, Su, Shou, Chu, Zhen, Si, Tai, Chuzhou, Yue, Li, Chi, She, Xin, Taiping, Rao, Xuan, Hong, Qian, Ji, Linjiang, Xingguo, Guangji, Nankang, Guangde, and Changge one each; Heliu four.
translations.idiomatic: Three each at Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Ningling; two each at Chenliu, Xianping, Dongming, Bo, Heyin, and Yongcheng; five at the Southern Capital; one each at Taikang, Yangwu, Xu, Jiangning, Yang, Lu, Su, Shou, Chu, Zhen, Si, Tai, Chuzhou, Yue, Li, Chi, She, Xin, Taiping, Rao, Xuan, Hong, Qian, Ji, Linjiang, Xingguo, Guangji, Nankang, Guangde, and Changge; four at Heliu.

sentences.zh: 神威咸平三年，選京師諸司庫務兵立。

translations.literal: Divine Awesome—in the third year of Xianping, troops from various bureau storehouses at the capital were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Awesome was established in Xianping 3 by selecting troops from various bureau storehouses at the capital.

sentences.zh: 上下指揮十三。

translations.literal: Upper and lower thirteen commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen upper and lower commands in all.

sentences.zh: 陳留三，許、鞏各二，雍丘、考城、咸平、河陽、廣濟、白波各一。

translations.literal: Chenliu three; Xu and Gong two each; Yongqiu, Kaocheng, Xianping, Heyang, Guangji, and White Wave one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three at Chenliu; two each at Xu and Gong; one each at Yongqiu, Kaocheng, Xianping, Heyang, Guangji, and White Wave.

sentences.zh: 歸遠雍熙三年，王師北征，拔飛狐、靈丘，得其降卒立，咸平二年，選諸州雜犯兵增之。

translations.literal: Return Distance—in the third year of Yongxi, the imperial army marched north, captured Feihu and Lingqiu, and established with surrendered troops; in the second year of Xianping, miscellaneous offenders from various prefectures were selected to supplement it.
translations.idiomatic: Return Distance was established in Yongxi 3 when the imperial army marched north, took Feihu and Lingqiu, and enrolled surrendered troops; in Xianping 2, miscellaneous offenders from various prefectures were added.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮三，天聖中，增置爲十六。

translations.literal: Formerly three commands; during Tiansheng, increased to sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered three commands; during Tiansheng, it was increased to sixteen.

sentences.zh: 陳、許、亳、壽、宿、鄧、襄、鼎各一，荊南、澧、潭、洪各二。

translations.literal: Chen, Xu, Bo, Shou, Su, Deng, Xiang, and Ding one each; Jingnan, Li, Tan, and Hong two each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Chen, Xu, Bo, Shou, Su, Deng, Xiang, and Ding; two each at Jingnan, Li, Tan, and Hong.

sentences.zh: 雄略咸平六年，選諸州廂兵及香藥遞鋪兵立。

translations.literal: Bold Strategy—in the sixth year of Xianping, garrison troops from various prefectures and spice relay-station troops were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Bold Strategy was established in Xianping 6 by selecting garrison troops from various prefectures and spice relay-station troops.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮十五，皇祐五年，增置爲二十五。

translations.literal: Formerly fifteen commands; in the fifth year of Huangyou, increased to twenty-five.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered fifteen commands; in Huangyou 5, it was increased to twenty-five.

sentences.zh: 荊南五，潭四，鼎、澧各二，廣、辰、桂各二，許、全、邵、容各一。

translations.literal: Jingnan five; Tan four; Ding and Li two each; Guang, Chen, and Gui two each; Xu, Quan, Shao, and Rong one each.
translations.idiomatic: Five at Jingnan; four at Tan; two each at Ding, Li, Guang, Chen, and Gui; one each at Xu, Quan, Shao, and Rong.

sentences.zh: 威猛咸平三年，選諸州廂兵及召募者立。

translations.literal: Fierce Awesome—in the third year of Xianping, garrison troops from various prefectures and recruits were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce Awesome was established in Xianping 3 by selecting garrison troops from various prefectures and recruits.

sentences.zh: 上下指揮十。

translations.literal: Upper and lower ten commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Ten upper and lower commands in all.

sentences.zh: 襄邑四，咸平、許、長葛各二。

translations.literal: Xiangyi four; Xianping, Xu, and Changge two each.
translations.idiomatic: Four at Xiangyi; two each at Xianping, Xu, and Changge.

sentences.zh: 神銳咸平六年，料簡河東兵立。

translations.literal: Divine Sharp—in the sixth year of Xianping, Hedong troops were assessed and selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Sharp was established in Xianping 6 by assessing and selecting Hedong troops.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，以本軍及神虎兵年多者爲帶甲剩員。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, long-serving men of this army and Divine Tiger troops were made armored surplus personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 5, long-serving men of this army and Divine Tiger troops were made armored surplus personnel.

sentences.zh: 指揮二十六。

translations.literal: Twenty-six commands.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six commands.

sentences.zh: 太原六，潞、晉各三，澤、汾、隰、平定各二，代、絳、忻、遼、邢、威勝各一。

translations.literal: Taiyuan six; Lu and Jin three each; Ze, Fen, Xi, and Pingding two each; Dai, Jiang, Xin, Liao, Xing, and Weisheng one each.
translations.idiomatic: Six at Taiyuan; three each at Lu and Jin; two each at Ze, Fen, Xi, and Pingding; one each at Dai, Jiang, Xin, Liao, Xing, and Weisheng.

sentences.zh: 神虎咸平五年，選陝西州兵馬立。

translations.literal: Divine Tiger—in the fifth year of Xianping, Shaanxi prefectural troops and horses were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Tiger was established in Xianping 5 by selecting Shaanxi prefectural troops and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 六年，又料簡河東州兵立，以西路河東兵之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Hedong prefectural troops were again assessed and selected to establish it, using western-route Hedong troops for it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, Hedong prefectural troops were assessed and selected for the unit, drawn from western-route Hedong forces.

sentences.zh: 指揮二十六。

translations.literal: Twenty-six commands.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six commands.

sentences.zh: 永興六，鳳翔、河中、忻、晉、威勝各二，太原、秦、延、鄜、華各一，潞州三。

translations.literal: Yongxing six; Fengxiang, Hezhong, Xin, Jin, and Weisheng two each; Taiyuan, Qin, Yan, Fu, and Hua one each; Luzhou three.
translations.idiomatic: Six at Yongxing; two each at Fengxiang, Hezhong, Xin, Jin, and Weisheng; one each at Taiyuan, Qin, Yan, Fu, and Hua; three at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 保捷咸平四年，詔陝西沿邊選鄉丁保毅升充。

translations.literal: Secure Swift—in the fourth year of Xianping, an edict ordered selection along the Shaanxi frontier of village militia and Secure Resolve troops for promotion and filling its ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Secure Swift: in Xianping 4, an edict ordered frontier village militia and Secure Resolve troops in Shaanxi promoted into its ranks.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮四十五，慶曆中，揀鄉弓手增置，總一百三十五。

translations.literal: Formerly forty-five commands; during Qingli, village archers were selected and added, totaling one hundred thirty-five.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered forty-five commands; during Qingli, village archers were selected and added, raising the total to one hundred thirty-five.

sentences.zh: 永興十二，同九，秦八，河中、汾、涇各七，渭、寧、耀各六，鳳翔、延、儀、華、隴、解、乾各五，陝、原、鄜各四，成三，慶、鳳、坊、晉、鎮戎各二，環、丹、商、虢、階、慶成、德順各一。

translations.literal: Yongxing twelve; Tong nine; Qin eight; Hezhong, Fen, and Jing seven each; Wei, Ning, and Yao six each; Fengxiang, Yan, Yi, Hua, Long, Jie, and Qian five each; Shan, Yuan, and Fu four each; Cheng three; Qing, Feng, Fang, Jin, and Zhenrong two each; Huan, Dan, Shang, Guo, Jie, Qingcheng, and Deshun one each.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve at Yongxing; nine at Tong; eight at Qin; seven each at Hezhong, Fen, and Jing; six each at Wei, Ning, and Yao; five each at Fengxiang, Yan, Yi, Hua, Long, Jie, and Qian; four each at Shan, Yuan, and Fu; three at Cheng; two each at Qing, Feng, Fang, Jin, and Zhenrong; one each at Huan, Dan, Shang, Guo, Jie, Qingcheng, and Deshun.

sentences.zh: 振武舊指揮四十，慶曆後，河北增置爲指揮四十二，陝西增置爲指揮三十九，總八十一。

translations.literal: Quelling Martial formerly forty commands; after Qingli, Hebei was increased to forty-two commands, Shaanxi increased to thirty-nine commands, totaling eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Quelling Martial formerly numbered forty commands; after Qingli, Hebei was raised to forty-two commands and Shaanxi to thirty-nine, for eighty-one in all.

sentences.zh: 北京、澶、相、懷、衛、霸、莫、祁、棣、趙、濱、洺、保安、永寧、通利、安肅、儀各一，真定、定、瀛、保、恩、邢、深、博、永靜、乾、寧陵、涇各二，延六，邠、隴各七，鄜、寧各五，磁四，滄、原各三。

translations.literal: Beijing, Chan, Xiang, Huai, Wei, Ba, Mo, Qi, Di, Zhao, Bin, Ming, Bao'an, Yongning, Tongli, Ansu, and Yi one each; Zhending, Ding, Ying, Bao, En, Xing, Shen, Bo, Yongjing, Qian, Ningling, and Jing two each; Yan six; Bin and Long seven each; Fu and Ning five each; Ci four; Cang and Yuan three each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Beijing, Chan, Xiang, Huai, Wei, Ba, Mo, Qi, Di, Zhao, Bin, Ming, Bao'an, Yongning, Tongli, Ansu, and Yi; two each at Zhending, Ding, Ying, Bao, En, Xing, Shen, Bo, Yongjing, Qian, Ningling, and Jing; six at Yan; seven each at Bin and Long; five each at Fu and Ning; four at Ci; three each at Cang and Yuan.

sentences.zh: 橋道太平興國三年，選諸州廂兵次等者立。

translations.literal: Bridge Road—in the third year of Taiping Xingguo, second-grade garrison troops from various prefectures were selected to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Bridge Road was established in Taiping Xingguo 3 by selecting second-grade garrison troops from various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧爲川橋道。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, Mighty Oars and Subdue Tranquility of the Sichuan Gorges were further selected as Sichuan Bridge Road.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4, the Sichuan Gorges units Mighty Oars and Subdue Tranquility were further selected as Sichuan Bridge Road.

sentences.zh: 總指揮十八。

translations.literal: Eighteen commands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen commands in all.

sentences.zh: 襄邑、咸平、陽武各二，陳留、東明、尉氏、太康、西京、河陽、濮、鄆、鞏、河陰、白波、寧陵各一。

translations.literal: Xiangyi, Xianping, and Yangwu two each; Chenliu, Dongming, Weishi, Taikang, Xijing, Heyang, Pu, Yun, Gong, Heyin, Baibo, and Ningling one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two each at Xiangyi, Xianping, and Yangwu; one each at Chenliu, Dongming, Weishi, Taikang, Xijing, Heyang, Pu, Yun, Gong, Heyin, Baibo, and Ningling.

sentences.zh: 清塞太平興國初立。

translations.literal: Clear Barrier—established at the beginning of Taiping Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: Clear Barrier was established at the beginning of the Taiping Xingguo era.

sentences.zh: 左、右廂，舊指揮二十三，嘉祐中並爲十三。

translations.literal: Left and right wings; formerly twenty-three commands; during Jiayou, merged to thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right wings; formerly twenty-three commands; during Jiayou, they were consolidated to thirteen.

sentences.zh: 曹二，鄭、鄆、滑、通利、鞏、河陰、白波、汜水、長葛各一。

translations.literal: Cao two; Zheng, Yun, Hua, Tongli, Gong, Heyin, Baibo, Sishui, and Changge one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two at Cao; one each at Zheng, Yun, Hua, Tongli, Gong, Heyin, Baibo, Sishui, and Changge.

sentences.zh: 招收端拱中，獲通州大沙洲賊衆立，缺則以江、浙招致海賊補之。

translations.literal: Recruitment—in the Duan Gong period, established from bandits captured at Tongzhou's Great Sandy Isle; vacancies were filled by recruiting coastal pirates from Jiang and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Recruitment was established in the Duan Gong period from bandits captured at Tongzhou's Great Sandy Isle; vacancies were filled by recruiting coastal pirates from Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 又收端拱中逃軍來復者，原其罪爲德壽軍，後改今名，隸保州巡檢司，慶曆初，升禁軍，爲指揮十七。

translations.literal: It also took deserters who returned in the Duan Gong period, pardoned their crimes as the Virtue Longevity Army, later changed to the present name, subordinate to the Baozhou patrol office; at the beginning of Qingli, promoted to the Palace Army, becoming seventeen commands.
translations.idiomatic: It also enrolled deserters who returned during Duan Gong, pardoned them as the Virtue Longevity Army, later renamed to its present title, and placed under the Baozhou patrol office; at the start of Qingli it was promoted to the Palace Army as seventeen commands.

sentences.zh: 保四，霸、信安各三，定、軍城砦各二，廣信、安肅、順安各一。

translations.literal: Bao four; Ba and Xin'an three each; Ding and Juncheng Stockade two each; Guangxin, Ansu, and Shun'an one each.
translations.idiomatic: Four at Bao; three each at Ba and Xin'an; two each at Ding and Juncheng Stockade; one each at Guangxin, Ansu, and Shun'an.

sentences.zh: 壯勇本招獲群盜配近京徒役者揀拔立，咸平三年，選諸雜犯兵增之。

translations.literal: Robust Valor—originally established by selecting from bandits captured and assigned to corvée near the capital; in the third year of Xianping, various convict soldiers were selected to augment it.
translations.idiomatic: Robust Valor was originally raised by selecting captured bandits assigned to corvée near the capital; in Xianping 3, various convict soldiers were selected to augment it.

sentences.zh: 至道三年，江、浙發運使楊允恭禽海賊送闕下增補，旋廢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhidao, Yang Yungong, transport commissioner of Jiang and Zhe, captured sea pirates and sent them to court for augmentation; it was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 3, Yang Yungong, transport commissioner for Jiangsu and Zhejiang, captured sea pirates and sent them to court to fill its ranks; the unit was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮三，慶曆中，增置爲七。

translations.literal: Formerly three commands; during Qingli, increased to seven.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered three commands; during Qingli, it was increased to seven.

sentences.zh: 耀、解、滑各二，許一。

translations.literal: Yao, Jie, and Hua two each; Xu one.
translations.idiomatic: Two each at Yao, Jie, and Hua; one at Xu.

sentences.zh: 宣效咸平三年，選六軍、窯務、軍營務、天駟監效役、店宅務、州兵立。

translations.literal: Manifest Effect—in the third year of Xianping, selected from the Six Armies, the Kiln Office, the Military Camp Office, Imperial Stud corvée labor, the Hostel Office, and prefectural troops to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: Manifest Effect was established in Xianping 3 by selecting men from the Six Armies, the Kiln Office, the Military Camp Office, Imperial Stud corvée labor, the Hostel Office, and prefectural troops.

sentences.zh: 景德元年，又揀本軍材勇者爲揀中宣效。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingde, brave and able men of this army were further selected as Selected Manifest Effect.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 1, brave and able men of the unit were further selected as Selected Manifest Effect.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮五，後損爲二。

translations.literal: Formerly five commands; later reduced to two.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered five commands; later it was reduced to two.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: The capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 來化雍熙中，以飛狐、靈丘歸附之衆立，又以朔州內附牽擺兵立，後廢。

translations.literal: Come-to-Transform—in the Yongxi period, established from people who submitted from Feihu and Lingqiu, also established from Shizhou surrendered troops led away; later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Come-to-Transform was established in the Yongxi period from people who submitted at Feihu and Lingqiu, and also from Shizhou surrendered troops redirected inward; it was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 舊指揮三，後損爲二。

translations.literal: Formerly three commands; later reduced to two.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly numbered three commands; later it was reduced to two.

sentences.zh: 寧陵。

translations.literal: Ningling.
translations.idiomatic: At Ningling.

sentences.zh: 歸恩雍熙中，平塞陷邊之民黥面放還立，分有家屬者隸左廂，無者隸右廂。

translations.literal: Return Grace—in the Yongxi period, established from frontier people who had fallen to the enemy, tattooed and released; those with families were assigned to the left wing, those without to the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: Return Grace was established in the Yongxi period from frontier people who had been captured by the enemy, tattooed, and released; those with families served in the left wing, those without in the right.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 亳。

translations.literal: Bo.
translations.idiomatic: At Bo.

sentences.zh: 順化太平興國三年，以兩浙兵之次等者立。

translations.literal: Submit-to-Transform—in the third year of Taiping Xingguo, established from second-grade troops of the Two Zhejiang circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Submit-to-Transform was established in Taiping Xingguo 3 from second-grade troops of the Two Zhejiang circuits.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 河陽、鄆各一。

translations.literal: Heyang and Yun one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Heyang and Yun.

sentences.zh: 左右清衛大中祥符八年立，以奉諸宮觀灑掃之役。

translations.literal: Left and Right Clear Guard—established in the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, to serve sweeping and cleaning at the various palaces and temples.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Clear Guard was established in Dazhong Xiangfu 8 to perform sweeping and cleaning at the various palaces and temples.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 此下至強壯軍員凡八軍，天聖後無。

translations.literal: From here down to Robust Army Attendants, eight armies in all; none after Tiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: From here through Robust Army Attendants there were eight armies in all; none remained after the Tiansheng era.

sentences.zh: 川員僚直本西蜀賊全師雄所署將領，乾德中立。

translations.literal: Sichuan Staff Attendants Direct—originally generals appointed by the Western Shu bandit Quan Shixiong; established in the Qiande period.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Staff Attendants Direct were originally generals appointed by the Western Shu rebel Quan Shixiong; the unit was established in the Qiande period.

sentences.zh: 造船務乾德初，平荊湖，選其軍善治舟楫者立。

translations.literal: Shipbuilding Office—in early Qiande, after pacifying Jinghu, selected from that army those skilled at boats and ships to establish it.
translations.idiomatic: The Shipbuilding Office was established in early Qiande, after the pacification of Jinghu, by selecting from that army men skilled at building boats and ships.

sentences.zh: 歸明羽林太平興國四年，征幽州，獲其兵立。

translations.literal: Return-to-Ming Feathered Forest—in the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, on campaign against Youzhou, established from captured enemy troops.
translations.idiomatic: Return-to-Ming Feathered Forest was established in Taiping Xingguo 4 during the campaign against Youzhou from captured enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 新立清河緣河舊置鋪兵以備河決，後揀閱立。

translations.literal: Newly Established Clear River—originally relay-station troops were posted along the river against breaches; later established by inspection and selection.
translations.idiomatic: Newly Established Clear River had originally relied on relay-station troops posted along the river against breaches; the unit was later established by inspection and selection.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 保甯大中祥符元年，馬步軍都虞候王超請以病軍經行陣者立。

translations.literal: Secure Tranquility—in the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Cavalry and Infantry Vice Commander Wang Chao requested establishment from sick troops who had seen battle.
translations.idiomatic: Secure Tranquility was established in Dazhong Xiangfu 1 at the request of Cavalry and Infantry Vice Commander Wang Chao, using sick troops who had nonetheless seen battle.

sentences.zh: 新立歸化開寶七年，以江南李從善所領部曲水軍立，八年，平江南，又以降兵增之。

translations.literal: Newly Established Return-to-Transform—in the seventh year of Kaibao, established from naval troops under Li Congshan of Jiangnan; in the eighth year, after pacifying Jiangnan, augmented with surrendered troops.
translations.idiomatic: Newly Established Return-to-Transform was raised in Kaibao 7 from the naval followers of Li Congshan of Jiangnan; in year 8, after the pacification of Jiangnan, it was augmented with surrendered troops.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 強壯軍員咸平六年置，指揮一。

translations.literal: Robust Army Attendants—established in the sixth year of Xianping, one command.
translations.idiomatic: Robust Army Attendants were established in Xianping 6 as one command.

sentences.zh: 澄海弩手慶曆二年置，隸海州都巡檢司。

translations.literal: Clear Sea crossbowmen—established in the second year of Qingli, subordinate to the Haizhou supreme patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: Clear Sea crossbowmen were established in Qingli 2 and placed under the Haizhou supreme patrol office.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

translations.literal: Deng.
translations.idiomatic: At Deng.

sentences.zh: 此下至武嚴凡十三軍。

translations.literal: From here down to Martial Stern, thirteen armies in all.
translations.idiomatic: From here through Martial Stern there were thirteen armies in all.

sentences.zh: 捉生延州廂兵，天聖五年升禁軍，指揮二。

translations.literal: Capture Alive—Yanzhou garrison troops; in the fifth year of Tiansheng promoted to the Palace Army, two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Capture Alive began as Yanzhou garrison troops; in Tiansheng 5 it was promoted to the Palace Army as two commands.

sentences.zh: 清邊弩手寶元初，選陝西、河東廂軍之伉健者置，以弩手名。

translations.literal: Clear Border crossbowmen—at the beginning of Baoyuan, sturdy men were selected from Shaanxi and Hedong garrison troops to establish it, named for crossbowmen.
translations.idiomatic: Clear Border crossbowmen were established at the beginning of Baoyuan by selecting sturdy men from Shaanxi and Hedong garrison troops; the unit took its name from its crossbowmen.

sentences.zh: 指揮四十三。

translations.literal: Forty-three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-three commands.

sentences.zh: 太原九，秦五，涇四，河中、隴各三，永興、代、潞、晉各二，慶、環、滑、同、坊、鎮戎、慈、丹、隰、汾、憲各一。

translations.literal: Taiyuan nine; Qin five; Jing four; Hezhong and Long three each; Yongxing, Dai, Lu, and Jin two each; Qing, Huan, Hua, Tong, Fang, Zhenrong, Ci, Dan, Xi, Fen, and Xian one each.
translations.idiomatic: Nine at Taiyuan; five at Qin; four at Jing; three each at Hezhong and Long; two each at Yongxing, Dai, Lu, and Jin; one each at Qing, Huan, Hua, Tong, Fang, Zhenrong, Ci, Dan, Xi, Fen, and Xian.

sentences.zh: 制勝陝西廂兵，慶曆中，升禁軍。

translations.literal: Overcome Foe—Shaanxi garrison troops; during Qingli, promoted to the Palace Army.
translations.idiomatic: Overcome Foe began as Shaanxi garrison troops and was promoted to the Palace Army during Qingli.

sentences.zh: 指揮九。

translations.literal: Nine commands.
translations.idiomatic: Nine commands.

sentences.zh: 永興、華各二，鳳翔、耀、同、解、乾各一。

translations.literal: Yongxing and Hua two each; Fengxiang, Yao, Tong, Jie, and Qian one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two each at Yongxing and Hua; one each at Fengxiang, Yao, Tong, Jie, and Qian.

sentences.zh: 定功陝西廂軍，慶曆四年，升禁軍增置，爲指揮十。

translations.literal: Set Merit—Shaanxi garrison troops; in the fourth year of Qingli, promoted to the Palace Army and augmented, becoming ten commands.
translations.idiomatic: Set Merit began as Shaanxi garrison troops; in Qingli 4 it was promoted to the Palace Army and expanded to ten commands.

sentences.zh: 永興、秦、慶、原、渭、涇、儀、鄜、延、鎮戎各一。

translations.literal: Yongxing, Qin, Qing, Yuan, Wei, Jing, Yi, Fu, Yan, and Zhenrong one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Yongxing, Qin, Qing, Yuan, Wei, Jing, Yi, Fu, Yan, and Zhenrong.

sentences.zh: 清澗慶曆初，募土人精悍者充，因其地名。

translations.literal: Qingjian—at the beginning of Qingli, fierce local men were recruited to fill it, named for the place.
translations.idiomatic: Qingjian was established at the beginning of Qingli by recruiting fierce local men and took its name from the place.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 建威秦州廂兵，慶曆八年升禁軍。

translations.literal: Establish Might—Qinzhou garrison troops; in the eighth year of Qingli promoted to the Palace Army.
translations.idiomatic: Establish Might began as Qinzhou garrison troops and was promoted to the Palace Army in Qingli 8.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 效勇景祐中，募川峽流民增置，爲指揮二十七。

translations.literal: Effect Valor—during Jingyou, displaced people of the Sichuan Gorges were recruited and augmented, becoming twenty-seven commands.
translations.idiomatic: Effect Valor was expanded during Jingyou by recruiting displaced people of the Sichuan Gorges, reaching twenty-seven commands.

sentences.zh: 陳留三，太康、尉氏、襄邑、河陽、曹、合流各二，咸平、鄭、亳、衛、許、單、澶、磁、廣濟、河陰、甯陵、白波各一。

translations.literal: Chenliu three; Taikang, Weishi, Xiangyi, Heyang, Cao, and Heliu two each; Xianping, Zheng, Bo, Wei, Xu, Shan, Chan, Ci, Guangji, Heyin, Ningling, and Baibo one each.
translations.idiomatic: Three at Chenliu; two each at Taikang, Weishi, Xiangyi, Heyang, Cao, and Heliu; one each at Xianping, Zheng, Bo, Wei, Xu, Shan, Chan, Ci, Guangji, Heyin, Ningling, and Baibo.

sentences.zh: 宣毅慶曆中，京東、京西、河北、河東、淮南、江南、兩浙、荊湖、福建九路募健勇或選廂軍爲之。

translations.literal: Manifest Resolve—during Qingli, from the nine circuits of Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, Hedong, Huainan, Jiangnan, Two Zhejiang, Jinghu, and Fujian, brave men were recruited or garrison troops selected for it.
translations.idiomatic: Manifest Resolve was raised during Qingli across nine circuits—Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, Hedong, Huainan, Jiangnan, Two Zhejiang, Jinghu, and Fujian—by recruiting brave men or selecting garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 指揮二百八十八，至治平中，管一百七十四。

translations.literal: Two hundred eighty-eight commands; by the Zhiping period, administering one hundred seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: It numbered two hundred eighty-eight commands; by the Zhiping era it administered one hundred seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 京東路：南京、鄆、徐、曹、齊各二，青、兗、密、濮、沂、單、濟、淄、萊、濰、登、淮陽、廣濟各一；

translations.literal: Jingdong Circuit: Nanjing, Yun, Xu, Cao, and Qi two each; Qing, Yan, Mi, Pu, Yi, Shan, Ji, Zi, Lai, Wei, Deng, Huaiyang, and Guangji one each;
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong Circuit: two each at Nanjing, Yun, Xu, Cao, and Qi; one each at Qing, Yan, Mi, Pu, Yi, Shan, Ji, Zi, Lai, Wei, Deng, Huaiyang, and Guangji;

sentences.zh: 京西路：西京、滑、許、河陽、陳、襄、鄭、潁、蔡、汝、隨、信陽各一，鄧二。

translations.literal: Jingxi Circuit: Xijing, Hua, Xu, Heyang, Chen, Xiang, Zheng, Ying, Cai, Ru, Sui, and Xinyang one each; Deng two.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxi Circuit: one each at Xijing, Hua, Xu, Heyang, Chen, Xiang, Zheng, Ying, Cai, Ru, Sui, and Xinyang; two at Deng.

sentences.zh: 河北路：真定、德、棣、博、邢、祁、恩、磁、深、定、濱、通利、永靜、乾寧各一。

translations.literal: Hebei Circuit: Zhending, De, Di, Bo, Xing, Qi, En, Ci, Shen, Ding, Bin, Tongli, Yongjing, and Qianning one each.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei Circuit: one each at Zhending, De, Di, Bo, Xing, Qi, En, Ci, Shen, Ding, Bin, Tongli, Yongjing, and Qianning.

sentences.zh: 河東路：太原、汾各六，晉四，澤、絳、石、代各三，潞、嵐、忻、遼、威勝、平定各二，慈、隰、寧化各一。

translations.literal: Hedong Circuit: Taiyuan and Fen six each; Jin four; Ze, Jiang, Shi, and Dai three each; Lu, Lan, Xin, Liao, Weisheng, and Pingding two each; Ci, Xi, and Ninghua one each.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong Circuit: six each at Taiyuan and Fen; four at Jin; three each at Ze, Jiang, Shi, and Dai; two each at Lu, Lan, Xin, Liao, Weisheng, and Pingding; one each at Ci, Xi, and Ninghua.

sentences.zh: 淮南路：揚、亳各二，廬、宿、壽、楚、真、泗、蘄海、舒、泰、濠、和、光、黃、通、無爲、高郵、漣水各一。

translations.literal: Huainan Circuit: Yang and Bo two each; Lu, Su, Shou, Chu, Zhen, Si, Qi and Hai, Shu, Tai, Hao, He, Guang, Huang, Tong, Wuwei, Gaoyou, and Lianshui one each.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan Circuit: two each at Yang and Bo; one each at Lu, Su, Shou, Chu, Zhen, Si, Qi and Hai, Shu, Tai, Hao, He, Guang, Huang, Tong, Wuwei, Gaoyou, and Lianshui.

sentences.zh: 江南路：江甯、洪、虔、吉、撫、袁、筠、建昌、南安各一。

translations.literal: Jiangnan Circuit: Jiangning, Hong, Qian, Ji, Fu, Yuan, Jun, Jianchang, and Nan'an one each.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan Circuit: one each at Jiangning, Hong, Qian, Ji, Fu, Yuan, Jun, Jianchang, and Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 兩浙路：杭二，越、蘇、明、湖、婺、潤、溫、衢、常、秀、處各一。

translations.literal: Two Zhejiang Circuit: Hang two; Yue, Su, Ming, Hu, Wu, Run, Wen, Qu, Chang, Xiu, and Chu one each.
translations.idiomatic: Two Zhejiang Circuit: two at Hang; one each at Yue, Su, Ming, Hu, Wu, Run, Wen, Qu, Chang, Xiu, and Chu.

sentences.zh: 荊湖路：潭、全、鼎各三，荊南、邵、衡、永、郴、道、安、鄂、岳、澧、復、峽、歸、辰、荊門、漢陽、桂陽各一。

translations.literal: Jinghu Circuit: Tan, Quan, and Ding three each; Jingnan, Shao, Heng, Yong, Chen, Dao, An, E, Yue, Li, Fu, Xia, Gui, Chen, Jingmen, Hanyang, and Guiyang one each.
translations.idiomatic: Jinghu Circuit: three each at Tan, Quan, and Ding; one each at Jingnan, Shao, Heng, Yong, Chen, Dao, An, E, Yue, Li, Fu, Xia, Gui, Chen, Jingmen, Hanyang, and Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 福建路：建二，泉、南劍、漳、汀、邵武、興化各一。

translations.literal: Fujian Circuit: Jian two; Quan, Nanjian, Zhang, Ting, Shaowu, and Xinghua one each.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Circuit: two at Jian; one each at Quan, Nanjian, Zhang, Ting, Shaowu, and Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 宣毅床子弩炮手慶曆中置。

translations.literal: Manifest Resolve bed-frame crossbow artillerymen—established during Qingli.
translations.idiomatic: Manifest Resolve bed-frame crossbow artillerymen were established during Qingli.

sentences.zh: 指揮一。

translations.literal: One command.
translations.idiomatic: One command.

sentences.zh: 岢嵐。

translations.literal: Kelan.
translations.idiomatic: At Kelan.

sentences.zh: 建安府州廂兵，慶曆二年升禁軍。

translations.literal: Establish Peace—Fuzhou and Kelan garrison troops; in the second year of Qingli promoted to the Palace Army.
translations.idiomatic: Establish Peace began as Fuzhou and Kelan garrison troops and was promoted to the Palace Army in Qingli 2.

sentences.zh: 指揮二。

translations.literal: Two commands.
translations.idiomatic: Two commands.

sentences.zh: 府、嵐各一。

translations.literal: Fu and Lan one each.
translations.idiomatic: One each at Fu and Lan.

sentences.zh: 威果嘉祐四年置，指揮二十五。

translations.literal: Awesome Fruit—established in the fourth year of Jiayou, twenty-five commands.
translations.idiomatic: Awesome Fruit was established in Jiayou 4 as twenty-five commands.

sentences.zh: 荊南、江甯、杭、揚、廬、潭各三，洪、越、福各二，虔一。

translations.literal: Jingnan, Jiangning, Hang, Yang, Lu, and Tan three each; Hong, Yue, and Fu two each; Qian one.
translations.idiomatic: Three each at Jingnan, Jiangning, Hang, Yang, Lu, and Tan; two each at Hong, Yue, and Fu; one at Qian.

sentences.zh: 武嚴指揮一。

translations.literal: Martial Stern—one command.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Stern comprised one command.

sentences.zh: 京師。

translations.literal: The capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital.

sentences.zh: 御前忠佐軍頭司馬步軍都軍頭、副都軍頭，馬軍都軍頭、副都軍頭，步軍都軍頭、副都軍頭。

translations.literal: Before the Throne Loyal Assistants Army Head Bureau: Cavalry and Infantry Chief Army Head and Vice Chief Army Head; Cavalry Chief Army Head and Vice Chief Army Head; Infantry Chief Army Head and Vice Chief Army Head.
translations.idiomatic: The Before the Throne Loyal Assistants Army Head Bureau comprised Chief and Vice Chief Army Heads for combined cavalry and infantry, for cavalry alone, and for infantry alone.

sentences.zh: 其所轄散員，有副指揮使、軍使、副兵馬使、十將。

translations.literal: Among the dispersed attendants under its jurisdiction were Vice Commanders, Army Commanders, Vice Horse Commanders, and Ten Captains.
translations.idiomatic: Among the dispersed attendants under its command were Vice Commanders, Army Commanders, Vice Horse Commanders, and Ten Captains.

sentences.zh: 馬步直自指揮使而下，皆如殿前司之制。

translations.literal: Cavalry and Infantry Direct, from Commander downward, all followed the Palace Front Bureau system.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry and Infantry Direct, from the Commander down, followed the same system as the Palace Front Bureau.

sentences.zh: 御前忠佐散員本許州員僚剩員，淳化中，立爲軍頭司散員一班。

translations.literal: Before the Throne Loyal Assistants Dispersed Attendants—originally surplus staff attendants of Xuzhou; in the Chunhua period, established as one unit of dispersed attendants of the Army Head Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Throne Loyal Assistants Dispersed Attendants were originally surplus staff attendants from Xuzhou; in the Chunhua period they were organized as one unit of dispersed attendants under the Army Head Bureau.

sentences.zh: 又五代以來，軍校立功無可門署者，第令與諸校同其飲膳，名健飯都指揮使，後唯被譴者居此。

translations.literal: Also, since the Five Dynasties, officers who won merit but had no office to which they could be appointed were merely given the same food and drink as other officers, called Strong Meal Chief Commander; later only those under reprimand held this post.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Five Dynasties, officers who had won merit but had no post to which they could be appointed were given the same rations as other officers and styled Strong Meal Chief Commander; later only officers under reprimand held the position.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，改爲散指揮使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, changed to Dispersed Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 2, the title was changed to Dispersed Commander.

sentences.zh: 班一。

translations.literal: One unit.
translations.idiomatic: One unit.

sentences.zh: 馬直雍熙四年置，指揮一。

translations.literal: Cavalry Direct—established in the fourth year of Yongxi, one command.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry Direct was established in Yongxi 4 as one command.

sentences.zh: 步直端拱元年置，指揮一。

translations.literal: Infantry Direct—established in the first year of Duan Gong, one command.
translations.idiomatic: Infantry Direct was established in Duan Gong 1 as one command.

sentences.zh: 備軍一千九百六十人。

translations.literal: Reserve troops: one thousand nine hundred sixty men.
translations.idiomatic: Reserve troops numbered one thousand nine hundred sixty men.

sentences.zh: 皇城司親從官太平興國四年，分親事官之有材勇者爲之，給諸殿灑掃及契勘巡察之事。

translations.literal: Palace City Bureau Personal Attendants—in the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, selected from Personal Service Officers those with talent and courage; assigned sweeping at the various halls and verification and patrol duties.
translations.idiomatic: Palace City Bureau Personal Attendants were established in Taiping Xingguo 4 by selecting talented and courageous Personal Service Officers to sweep the various halls and carry out verification and patrol duties.

sentences.zh: 指揮三。

translations.literal: Three commands.
translations.idiomatic: Three commands.

sentences.zh: 入內院子天聖元年，揀親事官年高者爲之。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Courtyard Attendants: in the first year of Tiansheng, older personal-attendant officers were selected for this post.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Palace Courtyard Attendants were established in Tiansheng 1 by selecting older personal-attendant officers for the role.

sentences.zh: 九年，選輦官六十以上者充。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, imperial carriage officers aged sixty or above were chosen to fill the posts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, imperial carriage officers aged sixty or above were chosen to fill the posts.

sentences.zh: 治平二年，詔以五百人爲額。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiping, an edict fixed the quota at five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiping 2, an edict fixed the quota at five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 騏驥院騎御馬直太平興國二年置，分左右番。

translations.literal: Fine Horses Court Imperial Horse-Riding Direct: established in the second year of Taiping Xingguo, divided into left and right rotations.
translations.idiomatic: The Fine Horses Court Imperial Horse-Riding Direct was established in Taiping Xingguo 2 and divided into left and right rotations.

sentences.zh: 八年，分爲二直。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, it was divided into two Direct units.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, it was divided into two Direct units.

sentences.zh: 其後增置八直。

translations.literal: Later eight more Direct units were added.
translations.idiomatic: Later eight more Direct units were added.

sentences.zh: 左右教駿舊名左右備征，建隆二年改。

translations.literal: Left and Right Training Steeds were formerly called Left and Right Campaign-Ready; renamed in the second year of Jianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Training Steeds were formerly called Left and Right Campaign-Ready and were renamed in Jianlong 2.

sentences.zh: 指揮四。

translations.literal: Four commands.
translations.idiomatic: Four commands.
